sentences.speaker: James
sentences.cantonese: 早晨，Austin教授，你好嗎？
sentences.jyutping: zou2 san4, Austin gaau3 sau6, nei5 hou2 maa3?
sentences.english: Good morning, Professor Austin, how are you doing?

sentences.speaker: Professor Austin
sentences.cantonese: 早晨，James。我好好，多謝。你呢？
sentences.jyutping: zou2 san4, James. ngo5 hou2 hou2, do1 ze6. nei5 ne1?
sentences.english: Good morning, James. I am doing well. And you?

sentences.speaker: James
sentences.cantonese: 我好好，多謝你。呢位係我嘅朋友Emma。佢考慮報讀呢間大學，有啲問題想問你，可唔可以同我哋講下申請流程？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 hou2, do1 ze6 nei5. ni1 wai2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 pang4 jau5 Emma. keoi5 haau2 leoi6 bou3 duk6 ni1 gaan1 daai6 hok6, jau5 di1 man6 tai4 soeng2 man6 nei5, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 ngo5 dei6 gong2 haa5 san1 cing2 lau4 cing4?
sentences.english: I’m great, thank you. This is my friend Emma. She is thinking about applying to this college. She has a few questions. Would you mind telling us about the process, please?

sentences.speaker: Professor Austin
sentences.cantonese: 你好，Emma！好開心識到你。我非常樂意同你傾。下星期嚟我辦公室啦。
sentences.jyutping: nei5 hou2, Emma! hou2 hoi1 sam1 sik1 dou2 nei5. ngo5 fei1 soeng4 lok6 ji3 tung4 nei5 king1. haa6 sing1 kei4 lei4 ngo5 baan6 gung1 sat1 laa1.
sentences.english: Hello, Emma! It’s a pleasure to meet you. I’m more than happy to speak with you. Please stop by my office next week.

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.cantonese: 教授，見到你好開心，多謝你幫我哋。
sentences.jyutping: gaau3 sau6, gin3 dou2 nei5 hou2 hoi1 sam1, do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 dei6.
sentences.english: It’s a pleasure to meet you, professor. Thank you so much for helping us.

sentences.speaker: Professor Austin
sentences.cantonese: 唔使客氣，希望到時可以解答到你嘅問題！
sentences.jyutping: m4 sai2 haak3 hei3, hei1 mong6 dou3 si4 ho2 ji5 gaai2 daap3 dou2 nei5 ge3 man6 tai4!
sentences.english: Don’t mention it. Hopefully, I will be able to answer your questions!

sentences.speaker: Jane
sentences.cantonese: 嗨，Helen！最近點呀？
sentences.jyutping: haai1, Helen! zeoi3 gan6 dim2 aa3?
sentences.english: Hi, Helen! How’s it going?

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.cantonese: 我幾好，多謝，你呢？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 gei2 hou2, do1 ze6, nei5 ne1?
sentences.english: Fine, thanks — and you?

sentences.speaker: Jane
sentences.cantonese: 我都好好。你而家要去邊呀？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dou1 hou2 hou2. nei5 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 heoi3 bin1 aa3?
sentences.english: Just fine. Where are you off to?

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.cantonese: 去圖書館。我下星期有歷史考試，要開始溫書，唉。
sentences.jyutping: heoi3 tou4 syu1 gun2. ngo5 haa6 sing1 kei4 jau5 lik6 si2 haau2 si3, jiu3 hoi1 ci2 wan1 syu1, aai1.
sentences.english: To the library. I’ve got a history exam next week and need to start studying. Ugh.

sentences.speaker: Jane
sentences.cantonese: 哦係咁呀。咁我遲啲見你啦，祝你好運！
sentences.jyutping: o4 hai6 gam2 aa3. gam2 ngo5 ci4 di1 gin3 nei5 laa1, zuk1 nei5 hou2 wan6!
sentences.english: Oh, no. Well, I’ll see you later then. Good luck!

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.cantonese: 多謝，你遲啲見。
sentences.jyutping: do1 ze6, nei5 ci4 di1 gin3.
sentences.english: Thanks. See you later.

sentences.speaker: Margaret
sentences.cantonese: Wilson先生，我想介紹你識 Edward Smith博士。
sentences.jyutping: Wilson sin1 saang1, ngo5 soeng2 gaai3 siu6 nei5 sik1 Edward Smith bok3 si1.
sentences.english: Mr. Wilson, I’d like you to meet Dr. Edward Smith.

sentences.speaker: Mr. Wilson
sentences.cantonese: 好高興認識你，Smith博士。
sentences.jyutping: hou2 gou1 hing3 jing6 sik1 nei5, Smith bok3 si1.
sentences.english: It’s nice to meet you, Dr. Smith.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Smith
sentences.cantonese: 我都好高興認識你。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dou1 hou2 gou1 hing3 jing6 sik1 nei5.
sentences.english: Pleasure to meet you, too.

sentences.speaker: Margaret
sentences.cantonese: Smith博士係位經濟學家，佢啱啱寫完一本關於國際貿易嘅書。
sentences.jyutping: Smith bok3 si1 hai6 wai2 ging1 zai3 hok6 gaa1, keoi5 aam1 aam1 se2 jyun4 jat1 bun2 gwaan1 jyu1 gwok3 zai3 mau6 jik6 ge3 syu1.
sentences.english: Dr. Smith is an economist. He just finished writing a book on international trade.

sentences.speaker: Mr. Wilson
sentences.cantonese: 哦？呢個都係我嘅範疇。我喺聯合國做嘢。
sentences.jyutping: o4? ni1 go3 dou1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 faan6 cau4. ngo5 hai2 lyun4 hap6 gwok3 zou6 je5.
sentences.english: Oh? That’s my field, too. I work for the United Nations.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Smith
sentences.cantonese: 係咪喺發展計劃署做嘢呀？
sentences.jyutping: hai6 mai6 hai2 faat3 zin2 gai3 waak6 cyu5 zou6 je5 aa3?
sentences.english: In the Development Program, by any chance?

sentences.speaker: Mr. Wilson
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，你點知㗎？
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, nei5 dim2 zi1 gaa3?
sentences.english: Yes. How did you guess?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Smith
sentences.cantonese: 我睇過你寫嘅技術援助嘅文章，好精彩。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 gwo3 nei5 se2 ge3 gei6 seot6 wun4 zo6 ge3 man4 zoeng1, hou2 zing1 coi2.
sentences.english: I’ve read your articles on technical assistance. They’re excellent.

sentences.speaker: Jim
sentences.cantonese: 嗰個企喺Barbara隔離嘅高個女人係邊個呀？
sentences.jyutping: go2 go3 kei5 hai2 Barbara gaak3 lei4 ge3 gou1 go3 neoi5 jan2 hai6 bin1 go3 aa3?
sentences.english: Who’s the tall woman next to Barbara?

sentences.speaker: Charles
sentences.cantonese: 嗰個係佢嘅朋友Mary。你唔係喺Steve個派對見過佢咩？
sentences.jyutping: go2 go3 hai6 keoi5 ge3 pang4 jau5 Mary. nei5 m4 hai6 hai2 Steve go3 paai3 deoi3 gin3 gwo3 keoi5 me1?
sentences.english: That’s her friend Mary. Didn’t you meet her at Steve’s party?

sentences.speaker: Jim
sentences.cantonese: 冇呀，我冇去Steve個派對。
sentences.jyutping: mou5 aa3, ngo5 mou5 heoi3 Steve go3 paai3 deoi3.
sentences.english: No, I wasn’t at Steve’s party.

sentences.speaker: Charles
sentences.cantonese: 哦！咁而家介紹你哋識啦。Mary，呢位係我朋友Jim。
sentences.jyutping: o4! gam2 ji4 gaa1 gaai3 siu6 nei5 dei6 sik1 laa1. Mary, ni1 wai2 hai6 ngo5 pang4 jau5 Jim.
sentences.english: Oh! Then let me introduce you to her now. Mary, this is my friend Jim.

sentences.speaker: Mary
sentences.cantonese: 嗨，Jim。好開心識到你。
sentences.jyutping: haai1, Jim. hou2 hoi1 sam1 sik1 dou2 nei5.
sentences.english: Hi, Jim. Nice to meet you.

sentences.speaker: Jim
sentences.cantonese: 我都係。你想唔想飲啲嘢？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dou1 hai6. nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 jam2 di1 je5?
sentences.english: You, too. Would you like a drink?

sentences.speaker: Mary
sentences.cantonese: 好呀，我哋去攞嘢飲啦。
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 lo2 je5 jam2 laa1.
sentences.english: Sure, let’s go get one.

sentences.speaker: Natasha
sentences.cantonese: 而家幾點呀？我哋就快遲到啦！
sentences.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 gei2 dim2 aa3? ngo5 dei6 zau6 faai3 ci4 dou3 laa1!
sentences.english: What time is it? We’re going to be late!

sentences.speaker: Tony
sentences.cantonese: 而家七點一刻。我哋啱啱好，唔使驚。
sentences.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 cat1 dim2 jat1 hak1. ngo5 dei6 aam1 aam1 hou2, m4 sai2 geng1.
sentences.english: It’s a quarter after seven. We’re on time. Don’t panic.

sentences.speaker: Natasha
sentences.cantonese: 但我以為我哋七點半就要到餐廳㗎喎。咁大晚高峰，我哋一定去唔切㗎啦！
sentences.jyutping: daan6 ngo5 ji5 wai4 ngo5 dei6 cat1 dim2 bun3 zau6 jiu3 dou3 caan1 teng1 gaa3 wo3. gam2 daai6 maan5 gou1 fung1, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 heoi3 m4 cit3 gaa3 laa1!
sentences.english: But I thought we had to be at the restaurant by 7:30 for the surprise party. We’ll never make it there with all this evening traffic!

sentences.speaker: Tony
sentences.cantonese: 唔使啦，趕得切嘅。晚高峰就快過啦。不過我需要你幫我導航。可唔可以打去餐廳問下停車場喺邊？
sentences.jyutping: m4 sai2 laa1, gon2 dak1 cit3 ge3. maan5 gou1 fung1 zau6 faai3 gwo3 laa1. bat1 gwo3 ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 nei5 bong1 ngo5 dou6 hong4. ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 daa2 heoi3 caan1 teng1 man6 haa5 ting4 ce1 coeng4 hai2 bin1?
sentences.english: Sure we will. Rush hour is almost over. Anyway, the party starts at 8:00. But I do need help with directions. Can you call the restaurant and ask them where we park our car?

sentences.speaker: John
sentences.cantonese: 嗨，Alice，我係John。你好嗎？
sentences.jyutping: haai1, Alice, ngo5 hai6 John. nei5 hou2 maa3?
sentences.english: Hi, Alice, it’s John. How are you?

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.cantonese: 哎呀，John！我啱啱先諗起你。
sentences.jyutping: ai1 jaa3, John! ngo5 aam1 aam1 sin1 lam2 hei2 nei5.
sentences.english: Oh, hi, John! I was just thinking about you.

sentences.speaker: John
sentences.cantonese: 太好啦。我想問你今晚想唔想一齊去睇戲？
sentences.jyutping: taai3 hou2 laa1. ngo5 soeng2 man6 nei5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 hei3?
sentences.english: That’s nice. I was wondering if you’d like to go to a movie tonight.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.cantonese: 好呀，我好願意！有咩戲上映呀？
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3, ngo5 hou2 jyun6 ji3! jau5 me1 hei3 soeng5 jing2 aa3?
sentences.english: Sure, I’d love to! What’s playing?

sentences.speaker: John
sentences.cantonese: 我諗住睇嗰套新喜劇《Lights Out》。你覺得點？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 lam2 zyu6 tai2 go2 tou3 san1 hei2 kek6 'Lights Out'. nei5 gok3 dak1 dim2?
sentences.english: I was thinking about that new comedy Lights Out. What do you think?

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.cantonese: 聽落好正喎！
sentences.jyutping: teng1 lok6 hou2 zeng3 wo3!
sentences.english: Sounds great!

sentences.speaker: John
sentences.cantonese: 好，我七點半嚟接你。套戲八點開場。
sentences.jyutping: hou2, ngo5 cat1 dim2 bun3 lai4 zip3 nei5. tou3 hei3 baat3 dim2 hoi1 coeng4.
sentences.english: OK, I’ll pick you up around 7:30. The movie starts at 8:00.

sentences.speaker: Alice
sentences.cantonese: 咁到時見啦，Bye！
sentences.jyutping: gam2 dou3 si4 gin3 laa1, bai1!
sentences.english: See you then. Bye!

sentences.speaker: Luke
sentences.cantonese: 喂？嗨，Stephanie，公司嗰邊點呀？
sentences.jyutping: wai3? haai1, Stephanie, gung1 si1 go2 bin1 dim2 aa3?
sentences.english: Hello? Hi, Stephanie, how are things at the office?

sentences.speaker: Stephanie
sentences.cantonese: 嗨，Luke！你好嗎？你可唔可以順便買多啲打印紙？
sentences.jyutping: haai1, Luke! nei5 hou2 maa3? nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 seon6 bin2 maai5 do1 di1 daa2 jan2 zi2?
sentences.english: Hi, Luke! How are you? Can you please stop and pick up extra paper for the computer printer?

sentences.speaker: Luke
sentences.cantonese: 你講咩呀？可以再講一次嗎？你係咪話買墨水？唉，個電話斷斷續續。
sentences.jyutping: nei5 gong2 me1 aa3? ho2 ji5 zoi3 gong2 jat1 ci3 maa3? nei5 hai6 mai6 waa6 maai5 mak6 seoi2? aai1, go3 din6 waa2 tyun5 tyun5 zuk6 zuk6.
sentences.english: What did you say? Can you repeat that, please? Did you say to pick up ink for the printer? Sorry, the phone is cutting out.

sentences.speaker: Stephanie
sentences.cantonese: 而家聽到嗎？唔係，我係要電腦用紙。算啦，我發短訊畀你。多謝你，Luke，遲啲再講。
sentences.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 teng1 dou2 maa3? m4 hai6, ngo5 hai6 jiu3 din6 nou5 jung6 zi2. syun3 laa1, ngo5 faat3 dyun2 seon3 bei2 nei5. do1 ze6 nei5, Luke, ci4 di1 zoi3 gong2.
sentences.english: Can you hear me now? No, I need more computer paper. Listen, I’ll text you exactly what I need. Thanks, Luke. Talk to you later.

sentences.speaker: Luke
sentences.cantonese: 多謝你，Stephanie。唔好意思，我呢度個訊號好差。
sentences.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5, Stephanie. m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 ni1 dou6 go3 seon3 hou6 hou2 caa1.
sentences.english: Thanks, Stephanie. Sorry, my phone has really bad reception here.

sentences.speaker: Meg
sentences.cantonese: 哎呀，Julia！好耐冇見呀！
sentences.jyutping: ai1 jaa3, Julia! hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 aa3!
sentences.english: Well, hello there, Julia! Long time no see!

sentences.speaker: Julia
sentences.cantonese: Meg！嗨！真係好巧合呀！我好耐冇見你啦！你喺度做咩呀？
sentences.jyutping: Meg! haai1! zan1 hai6 hou2 hiu2 hap6 aa3! ngo5 hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 nei5 laa1! nei5 hai2 dou6 zou6 me1 aa3?
sentences.english: Meg! Hi! What a coincidence! I haven’t seen you in ages! What are you doing here?

sentences.speaker: Meg
sentences.cantonese: 我啱啱喺城入面搵到份新工，所以嚟買啲衫。喂，你覺得呢件衫點呀？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 aam1 aam1 hai2 sing4 jap6 min6 wan2 dou2 fan6 san1 gung1, so2 ji5 lei4 maai5 di1 saam1. wai3, nei5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gin6 saam1 dim2 aa3?
sentences.english: I just got a new job in the city, so I’m shopping for some clothes. Hey, what do you think of this shirt?

sentences.speaker: Julia
sentences.cantonese: 嗯……你知啦，我好鍾意藍色。你睇？我都有一件一樣嘅！
sentences.jyutping: ng4... nei5 zi1 laa1, ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 laam4 sik1. nei5 tai2? ngo5 dou1 jau5 jat1 gin6 jat1 joeng6 ge3!
sentences.english: Hmmm … well, you know how much I love blue. See? I’ve got the same shirt!

sentences.speaker: Meg
sentences.cantonese: 你一向都好有品味！真係世界細！
sentences.jyutping: nei5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hou2 jau5 ban2 mei6! zan1 hai6 sai3 gaai3 sai3!
sentences.english: You always did have good taste! What a small world.

sentences.speaker: Jennifer
sentences.cantonese: 出面凍到死！點解天氣報告話個冷鋒會過咗㗎？
sentences.jyutping: ceot1 min6 dung3 dou3 sei2! dim2 gaai2 tin1 hei3 bou3 gou3 waa6 go3 laang5 fung1 wui5 gwo3 zo2 gaa3?
sentences.english: It’s freezing outside! What happened to the weather report? I thought this cold front was supposed to pass.

sentences.speaker: Gabriela
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，我都以為係咁。我今朝上網睇都係咁講。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, ngo5 dou1 ji5 wai4 hai6 gam2. ngo5 gam1 ziu1 soeng5 mong5 tai2 dou1 hai6 gam2 gong2.
sentences.english: Yeah, I thought so too. That’s what I read online this morning.

sentences.speaker: Jennifer
sentences.cantonese: 可能係風寒效應令到體感溫度跌咗咁多。
sentences.jyutping: ho2 nang4 hai6 fung1 hon4 haau6 jing3 ling6 dou3 tai2 gam2 wan1 dou6 dit3 zo2 gam3 do1.
sentences.english: I guess the wind chill is really driving down the temperature.

sentences.speaker: Gabriela
sentences.cantonese: 不如我哋入去啦？我覺得我隻腳趾都開始冇知覺啦。
sentences.jyutping: bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 jap6 heoi3 laa1? ngo5 gok3 dak1 ngo5 zek3 goek3 zi2 dou1 hoi1 ci2 mou5 zi1 gok3 laa1.
sentences.english: Can we go inside? I feel like my toes are starting to go numb.

sentences.speaker: Jane
sentences.cantonese: 嗨，Margaret，聽講你升職喇？恭喜你！
sentences.jyutping: haai1, Margaret, teng1 gong2 nei5 sing1 zik1 laa3? gung1 hei2 nei5!
sentences.english: Hi, Margaret. I heard you got a promotion. Congratulations!

sentences.speaker: Margaret
sentences.cantonese: 多謝！我都好開心。
sentences.jyutping: do1 ze6! ngo5 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
sentences.english: Thanks! I’m really happy about it.

sentences.speaker: Jane
sentences.cantonese: 梗係啦，你一直都好努力。
sentences.jyutping: gang2 hai6 laa1, nei5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6.
sentences.english: Of course! You’ve worked hard for it.

sentences.speaker: Margaret
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，不過我而家就要應付更多責任喇。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, bat1 gwo3 ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zau6 jiu3 jing3 fu6 gang1 do1 zaak3 jam6 laa3.
sentences.english: Yes, but now I’ll be taking on more responsibility.

sentences.speaker: Jane
sentences.cantonese: 我相信你一定做得好好㗎！
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng1 seon3 nei5 jat1 ding6 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2 gaa3!
sentences.english: I’m sure you’ll do a wonderful job.

sentences.speaker: Margaret
sentences.cantonese: 你咁講真係好多謝你呀。
sentences.jyutping: nei5 gam2 gong2 zan1 hai6 hou2 do1 ze6 nei5 aa3.
sentences.english: That’s very kind of you to say.

sentences.speaker: Sherry
sentences.cantonese: 嗨，Tom，你星期六有冇時間？我生日，想請你嚟我屋企開派對。
sentences.jyutping: haai1, Tom, nei5 sing1 kei4 luk6 jau5 mou5 si4 gaan3? ngo5 saang1 jat6, soeng2 cing2 nei5 lei4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 hoi1 paai3 deoi3.
sentences.english: Hi, Tom. Are you free on Saturday? It’s my birthday and I’m having a party at my house.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.cantonese: 哦，聽落好正喎！幾點開始呀？
sentences.jyutping: o4, teng1 lok6 hou2 zeng3 wo3! gei2 dim2 hoi1 ci2 aa3?
sentences.english: Oh, that sounds great! What time does it start?

sentences.speaker: Sherry
sentences.cantonese: 大概七點鐘。不過你想早啲嚟都得。
sentences.jyutping: daai6 koi3 cat1 dim2 zung1. bat1 gwo3 nei5 soeng2 zou2 di1 lei4 dou1 dak1.
sentences.english: Around seven o’clock. But you can come earlier if you want.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.cantonese: 好呀，我一定會嚟㗎！要唔要我帶啲咩嚟？
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3, ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 lei4 gaa3! jiu3 m4 jiu3 ngo5 daai3 di1 me1 lei4?
sentences.english: Sure, I’d love to! Should I bring anything?

sentences.speaker: Sherry
sentences.cantonese: 唔使喇，只要你嚟就得啦！
sentences.jyutping: m4 sai2 laa3, zi2 jiu3 nei5 lei4 zau6 dak1 laa1!
sentences.english: No, just bring yourself!

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.cantonese: 咁好，到時見啦！同埋生日快樂！
sentences.jyutping: gam2 hou2, dou3 si4 gin3 laa1! tung4 maai4 saang1 jat6 faai3 lok6!
sentences.english: Great! See you then — and happy birthday!

sentences.speaker: Sherry
sentences.cantonese: 多謝你！星期六見！
sentences.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5! sing1 kei4 luk6 gin3!
sentences.english: Thanks! See you on Saturday!

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.cantonese: 你好，我今日會為你哋服務。要唔要先點啲飲品？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 hou2, ngo5 gam1 jat6 wui5 wai6 nei5 dei6 fuk6 mou6. jiu3 m4 jiu3 sin1 dim2 di1 jam2 ban2?
sentences.english: Hello, I’ll be your waiter today. Can I start you off with something to drink?

sentences.speaker: Ralph
sentences.cantonese: 要，請畀我一杯凍茶。
sentences.jyutping: jiu3, cing2 bei2 ngo5 jat1 bui1 dung3 caa4.
sentences.english: Yes. I’ll have iced tea, please.

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.cantonese: 我要檸檬水。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 ning4 mung1 seoi2.
sentences.english: And I’ll have lemonade.

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.cantonese: 好，咁你哋而家想落單定係要幾分鐘先？
sentences.jyutping: hou2, gam2 nei5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 soeng2 lok6 daan1 ding6 hai6 jiu3 gei2 fan1 zung1 sin1?
sentences.english: OK. Are you ready to order, or do you need a few minutes?

sentences.speaker: Ralph
sentences.cantonese: 我哋準備好啦。我前菜要蕃茄湯，主菜要烤牛肉配薯蓉同埋青豆。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2 laa1. ngo5 cin4 coi3 jiu3 faan1 ke2 tong1, zyu2 coi3 jiu3 haau1 ngau4 juk6 pui3 syu4 jung4 tung4 maai4 cing1 dau6.
sentences.english: I think we’re ready. I’ll have the tomato soup to start, and the roast beef with mashed potatoes and peas.

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.cantonese: 你想要幾成熟嘅牛肉？生、五成熟、定係全熟？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 jiu3 gei2 sing4 suk6 ge3 ngau4 juk6? saang1, ng5 sing4 suk6, ding6 hai6 cyun4 suk6?
sentences.english: How do you want the beef — rare, medium, or well done?

sentences.speaker: Ralph
sentences.cantonese: 全熟，唔該。
sentences.jyutping: cyun4 suk6, m4 goi1.
sentences.english: Well done, please.

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.cantonese: 我就淨係要魚，配薯仔同沙律。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zau6 zing6 hai6 jiu3 jyu2, pui3 syu4 zai2 tung4 saa1 leot6.
sentences.english: And I’ll just have the fish, with potatoes and a salad.

sentences.speaker: Doctor
sentences.cantonese: 有咩問題呀？
sentences.jyutping: jau5 me1 man6 tai4 aa3?
sentences.english: What seems to be the problem?

sentences.speaker: Cathy
sentences.cantonese: 嗯，我有好嚴重嘅咳嗽，喉嚨痛，仲有頭痛。
sentences.jyutping: ng4, ngo5 jau5 hou2 jim4 zung6 ge3 kat1 sau3, hau4 lung4 tung3, zung6 jau5 tau4 tung3.
sentences.english: Well, I have a bad cough and a sore throat. I also have a headache.

sentences.speaker: Doctor
sentences.cantonese: 你有呢啲症狀幾耐啦？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 jau5 ni1 di1 zing3 zong6 gei2 noi6 laa1?
sentences.english: How long have you had these symptoms?

sentences.speaker: Cathy
sentences.cantonese: 大概三日啦。我仲好攰。
sentences.jyutping: daai6 koi3 saam1 jat6 laa1. ngo5 zung6 hou2 gui6.
sentences.english: About three days now. And I’m really tired, too.

sentences.speaker: Doctor
sentences.cantonese: 嗯，聽落去你好似中咗流感。每四個鐘食一次阿士匹靈，休息多啲，記得多啲飲水。如果下星期仲未好就打畀我。
sentences.jyutping: ng4, teng1 lok6 heoi3 nei5 hou2 ci5 zung3 zo2 lau4 gam2. mui5 sei3 go3 zung1 sik6 jat1 ci3 aa3 si6 pat1 ling4, jau1 sik1 do1 di1, gei3 dak1 do1 di1 jam2 seoi2. jyu4 gwo2 haa6 sing1 kei4 zung6 mei6 hou2 zau6 daa2 bei2 ngo5.
sentences.english: Hmm. It sounds like you’ve got the flu. Take aspirin every four hours and get plenty of rest. Make sure you drink lots of fluids. Call me if you’re still sick next week.

sentences.speaker: Cathy
sentences.cantonese: 好，多謝你。
sentences.jyutping: hou2, do1 ze6 nei5.
sentences.english: OK, thanks.

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.cantonese: 唔好意思，你可唔可以話我知圖書館喺邊度？
sentences.jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 waa6 ngo5 zi1 tou4 syu1 gun2 hai2 bin1 dou6?
sentences.english: Excuse me. Could you tell me where the library is?

sentences.speaker: Nancy
sentences.cantonese: 可以呀，係嗰邊。你行三條街去到華盛頓街，然後轉右。喺街角，銀行對面就係。
sentences.jyutping: ho2 ji5 aa3, hai6 go2 bin1. nei5 haang4 saam1 tiu4 gaai1 heoi3 dou3 waa4 sing6 deon6 gaai1, jin4 hau6 zyun2 jau6. hai2 gaai1 gok3, ngan4 hong4 deoi3 min6 zau6 hai6.
sentences.english: Yes, it’s that way. You go three blocks to Washington Street, then turn right. It’s on the corner, across from the bank.

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.cantonese: 多謝呀！我啱啱嚟到冇幾日，所以我仲未熟路。
sentences.jyutping: do1 ze6 aa3! ngo5 aam1 aam1 lei4 dou3 mou5 gei2 jat6, so2 ji5 ngo5 zung6 mei6 suk6 lou6.
sentences.english: Thanks! I’ve only been in town a few days, so I really don’t know my way around yet.

sentences.speaker: Nancy
sentences.cantonese: 哦，我明你嘅感受。我哋搬嚟一年啦，我都仲未熟晒啲地方！
sentences.jyutping: o4, ngo5 ming4 nei5 ge3 gam2 sau6. ngo5 dei6 bun1 lei4 jat1 nin4 laa1, ngo5 dou1 zung6 mei6 suk6 saai3 di1 dei6 fong1!
sentences.english: Oh, I know how you feel. We moved here a year ago, and I still don’t know where everything is!

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.cantonese: 喂！嗰架車啱啱闖紅燈撞咗嗰架貨車！
sentences.jyutping: wai3! go2 gaa3 ce1 aam1 aam1 cong2 hung4 dang1 zong6 zo2 go2 gaa3 fo3 ce1!
sentences.english: Hey! That car just ran a red light and hit that truck!

sentences.speaker: Gail
sentences.cantonese: 有人受傷嗎？
sentences.jyutping: jau5 jan4 sau6 soeng1 maa3?
sentences.english: Is anyone hurt?

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.cantonese: 我唔清楚……我哋打911啦。… 喂？我想報告一單車禍，喺查爾斯街郵局附近。好似有個男人受傷。係，啱啱發生嘅。好，多謝。再見。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 m4 cing1 co2... ngo5 dei6 daa2 gau2 jat1 jat1 jat1 laa1. ... wai3? ngo5 soeng2 bou3 gou3 jat1 daan1 ce1 wo6, hai2 chaa4 ji5 si1 gaai1 jau4 guk6 fu6 gan6. hou2 ci5 jau5 go3 naam4 jan4 sau6 soeng1. hai6, aam1 aam1 faat3 sang1 ge3. hou2, do1 ze6. zoi3 gin3.
sentences.english: I don’t know … let’s call 911. … Hello? I’d like to report a car accident near the post office on Charles Street. It looks like a man is hurt. Yes, it just happened. OK, thanks. Bye.

sentences.speaker: Gail
sentences.cantonese: 佢哋點講？
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 dim2 gong2?
sentences.english: What did they say?

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.cantonese: 佢哋會即刻派救護車同警車嚟。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 wui5 zik1 hak1 paai3 gau3 wu6 ce1 tung4 ging2 ce1 lei4.
sentences.english: They’re going to send an ambulance and a police car right away.

sentences.speaker: Gail
sentences.cantonese: 好，佢哋嚟到喇。希望嗰個男人冇事。
sentences.jyutping: hou2, keoi5 dei6 lei4 dou3 laa3. hei1 mong6 go2 go3 naam4 jan4 mou5 si6.
sentences.english: Good, they’re here. I hope the man is OK.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，開車真係要小心啲。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, hoi1 ce1 zan1 hai6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
sentences.english: I know. You have to be so careful when you’re driving.

sentences.speaker: Salesperson
sentences.cantonese: 你好，需要幫手嗎？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 hou2, seoi1 jiu3 bong1 sau2 maa3?
sentences.english: Hello. May I help you?

sentences.speaker: Donna
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，我想買件新外套。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, ngo5 soeng2 maai5 gin6 san1 ngoi6 tou3.
sentences.english: Yes, I’m looking for a new jacket.

sentences.speaker: Salesperson
sentences.cantonese: 咁你想要咩款式？
sentences.jyutping: gam2 nei5 soeng2 jiu3 me1 fun2 sik1?
sentences.english: What style are you interested in?

sentences.speaker: Donna
sentences.cantonese: 嗯……要暖啲嘅，因為冬天好凍。
sentences.jyutping: ng4... jiu3 nyun5 di1 ge3, jan1 wai6 dung1 tin1 hou2 dung3.
sentences.english: Well, something warm because it gets cold in the winter.

sentences.speaker: Salesperson
sentences.cantonese: 呢件好受歡迎，仲有唔同嘅顏色。
sentences.jyutping: ni1 gin6 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4, zung6 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 ngaan4 sik1.
sentences.english: This one is very popular, and it comes in several colors.

sentences.speaker: Donna
sentences.cantonese: 嗯……我鍾意藍色。可以試吓嗎？
sentences.jyutping: ng4... ngo5 zung1 ji3 laam4 sik1. ho2 ji5 si3 haa5 maa3?
sentences.english: Hmm … I like the blue one. Can I try it on?

sentences.speaker: Salesperson
sentences.cantonese: 當然可以！更衣室喺度。
sentences.jyutping: dong1 jin4 ho2 ji5! gang1 ji1 sat1 hai2 dou6.
sentences.english: Of course! The fitting room is right over there.

sentences.speaker: Donna
sentences.cantonese: 呢件好啱尺寸。我就要呢件啦，多謝你！
sentences.jyutping: ni1 gin6 hou2 aam1 cek3 cyun3. ngo5 zau6 jiu3 ni1 gin6 laa1, do1 ze6 nei5!
sentences.english: It fits perfectly. I’ll take it. Thank you!

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.cantonese: 喂，Linda？我係Tom。我想問下你今晚有冇空？
sentences.jyutping: wai3, Linda? ngo5 hai6 Tom. ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 nei5 gam1 maan5 jau5 mou5 hung1?
sentences.english: Hello, Linda? This is Tom. I was wondering if you’re free tonight.

sentences.speaker: Linda
sentences.cantonese: 哦，嗨，Tom。我今晚應該得閒。點解呀？
sentences.jyutping: o4, haai1, Tom. ngo5 gam1 maan5 jing1 goi1 dak1 haan4. dim2 gaai2 aa3?
sentences.english: Oh, hi Tom. I think I’m free tonight. Why?

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.cantonese: 我想知你想唔想一齊去睇場電影？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zi1 nei5 soeng2 m4 soeng2 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 coeng4 din6 jing2?
sentences.english: I wanted to know if you’d like to go see a movie with me.

sentences.speaker: Linda
sentences.cantonese: 聽落幾好喎！但你想睇咩戲？
sentences.jyutping: teng1 lok6 gei2 hou2 wo3! daan6 nei5 soeng2 tai2 me1 hei3?
sentences.english: That sounds great! But what movie do you want to see?

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.cantonese: 我聽講新嗰套動作片好正。你點睇？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 gong2 san1 go2 tou3 dung6 zok3 pin2 hou2 zeng3. nei5 dim2 tai2?
sentences.english: I heard the new action movie is really good. What do you think?

sentences.speaker: Linda
sentences.cantonese: 嗯……我平時唔太睇動作片，不過試下都可以。
sentences.jyutping: ng4... ngo5 ping4 si4 m4 taai3 tai2 dung6 zok3 pin2, bat1 gwo3 si3 haa5 dou1 ho2 ji5.
sentences.english: Hmm … I don’t usually watch action movies, but I guess I could try it.

sentences.speaker: Tom
sentences.cantonese: 太好啦！我七點半嚟接你，得唔得？
sentences.jyutping: taai3 hou2 laa1! ngo5 cat1 dim2 bun3 lei4 zip3 nei5, dak1 m4 dak1?
sentences.english: Great! I’ll pick you up at 7:30, OK?

sentences.speaker: Linda
sentences.cantonese: 得呀，到時見！
sentences.jyutping: dak1 aa3, dou3 si4 gin3!
sentences.english: Sure. See you then!

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.cantonese: 我好期待下個月嘅假期！你有冇諗過我哋想去邊度？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 kei4 doi6 haa6 go3 jyut6 ge3 gaa3 kei4! nei5 jau5 mou5 nam2 gwo3 ngo5 dei6 soeng2 heoi3 bin1 dou6?
sentences.english: I’m really looking forward to our vacation next month! Have you thought about where we should go?

sentences.speaker: Kevin
sentences.cantonese: 我諗過呀。我覺得我哋應該去海邊！天氣會啱曬。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 nam2 gwo3 aa3. ngo5 gok3 dak1 ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 heoi3 hoi2 bin1! tin1 hei3 wui5 aam1 saai3.
sentences.english: Yeah, I’ve been thinking. I think we should go to the beach! The weather will be perfect.

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.cantonese: 聽落好正喎！我都想曬太陽放鬆下。
sentences.jyutping: teng1 lok6 hou2 zeng3 wo3! ngo5 dou1 soeng2 saai3 taai3 joeng4 fong3 sung1 haa5.
sentences.english: That sounds great! I’d love to relax and get some sun.

sentences.speaker: Kevin
sentences.cantonese: 我哋可以租架車，咁樣去唔同嘅地方會方便好多。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 zou1 gaa3 ce1, gam2 joeng6 heoi3 m4 tung4 ge3 dei6 fong1 wui5 fong1 bin6 hou2 do1.
sentences.english: We could rent a car. That way we can visit lots of different places easily.

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.cantonese: 好主意！不過我哋最好早啲book酒店，唔係會冇房。
sentences.jyutping: hou2 zyu2 ji3! bat1 gwo3 ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hou2 zou2 di1 buk1 zau2 dim3, m4 hai6 wui5 mou5 fong4.
sentences.english: Good idea! But we should book a hotel soon or there won’t be any rooms left.

sentences.speaker: Kevin
sentences.cantonese: 啱啱，我今晚就查下酒店同租車嘅價錢。
sentences.jyutping: aam1 aam1, ngo5 gam1 maan5 zau6 caa4 haa5 zau2 dim3 tung4 zou1 ce1 ge3 gaa3 cin2.
sentences.english: You’re right. I’ll check hotel and car rental prices tonight.

sentences.speaker: Sarah
sentences.cantonese: 太好啦！我哋一定會有個好開心嘅旅行。
sentences.jyutping: taai3 hou2 laa1! ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 wui5 jau5 go3 hou2 hoi1 sam1 ge3 leoi5 hang4.
sentences.english: Perfect! We’re going to have a wonderful trip.

sentences.speaker: Clerk
sentences.cantonese: 你好，我可以幫你嗎？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 hou2, ngo5 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 maa3?
sentences.english: Hello. How can I help you?

sentences.speaker: Henry
sentences.cantonese: 我想開一個新嘅儲蓄戶口。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 hoi1 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 cyu5 cuk1 wu6 hau2.
sentences.english: I’d like to open a new savings account.

sentences.speaker: Clerk
sentences.cantonese: 可以，請你出示身份證同住址證明。
sentences.jyutping: ho2 ji5, cing2 nei5 ceot1 si6 san1 fan6 zing3 tung4 zyu6 zi2 zing3 ming4.
sentences.english: Sure. I’ll need your ID and proof of address.

sentences.speaker: Henry
sentences.cantonese: 喺度，呢啲係我嘅文件。
sentences.jyutping: hai2 dou6, ni1 di1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 man4 gin2.
sentences.english: Here you go. These are my documents.

sentences.speaker: Clerk
sentences.cantonese: 多謝。我會幫你處理。你都可以加張提款卡，免費嘅。
sentences.jyutping: do1 ze6. ngo5 wui5 bong1 nei5 cyu5 lei5. nei5 dou1 ho2 ji5 gaa1 zoeng1 tai4 fun2 kaat1, min5 fai3 ge3.
sentences.english: Thank you. I’ll process this for you. You can also get a debit card. It’s free.

sentences.speaker: Henry
sentences.cantonese: 咁好呀，我要一張，多謝。
sentences.jyutping: gam2 hou2 aa3, ngo5 jiu3 jat1 zoeng1, do1 ze6.
sentences.english: That’s great. I’ll take one. Thanks.

sentences.speaker: Clerk
sentences.cantonese: 好啦，全部搞掂，你嘅新戶口已經開好啦！
sentences.jyutping: hou2 laa1, cyun4 bou6 gaau2 dim6, nei5 ge3 san1 wu6 hau2 ji5 ging1 hoi1 hou2 laa1!
sentences.english: All right, everything is set. Your new account is now open!

sentences.speaker: Emily
sentences.cantonese: 你今日喺學校點呀？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 hai2 hok6 haau6 dim2 aa3?
sentences.english: How was school today?

sentences.speaker: Josh
sentences.cantonese: 嗯……都OK，不過我哋有個突擊測驗！
sentences.jyutping: ng4... dou1 OK, bat1 gwo3 ngo5 dei6 jau5 go3 dat6 gik1 caak1 jim6!
sentences.english: Uh… it was fine, but we had a surprise quiz!

sentences.speaker: Emily
sentences.cantonese: 哎吔！你覺得考成點？
sentences.jyutping: ai1 jaa3! nei5 gok3 dak1 haau2 sing4 dim2?
sentences.english: Oh no! How do you think you did?

sentences.speaker: Josh
sentences.cantonese: 我諗我應該合格，不過唔係好有信心。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 nam2 ngo5 jing1 goi1 hap6 gaak3, bat1 gwo3 m4 hai6 hou2 jau5 seon3 sam1.
sentences.english: I think I passed, but I’m not totally sure.

sentences.speaker: Emily
sentences.cantonese: 唔緊要啦，你平時都讀得好好。
sentences.jyutping: m4 gan2 jiu3 laa1, nei5 ping4 si4 dou1 duk6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
sentences.english: Don’t worry. You usually do really well.

sentences.speaker: Josh
sentences.cantonese: 希望啦。另外，我下星期要做個科學報告。
sentences.jyutping: hei1 mong6 laa1. ling6 ngoi6, ngo5 haa6 sing1 kei4 jiu3 zou6 go3 fo1 hok6 bou3 gou3.
sentences.english: I hope so. Also, I have to do a science report next week.

sentences.speaker: Emily
sentences.cantonese: 講咩嘢嘅？
sentences.jyutping: gong2 me1 je5 ge3?
sentences.english: What’s it about?

sentences.speaker: Josh
sentences.cantonese: 講火山爆發。我仲要做模型添。
sentences.jyutping: gong2 fo2 saan1 baau3 faat3. ngo5 zung6 jiu3 zou6 mou4 jing4 tim1.
sentences.english: Volcanoes. And I have to build a model.

sentences.speaker: Emily
sentences.cantonese: 哇，咁好玩！如果你需要幫手就同我講。
sentences.jyutping: waa1, gam3 hou2 waan2! jyu4 gwo2 nei5 seoi1 jiu3 bong1 sau2 zau6 tung4 ngo5 gong2.
sentences.english: Wow, that sounds fun! Let me know if you need help.

sentences.speaker: Olivia
sentences.cantonese: 今日真係好熱呀！我差啲中暑添！
sentences.jyutping: gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 jit6 aa3! ngo5 caa1 di1 zung3 syu2 tim1!
sentences.english: It’s really hot today! I almost got heatstroke!

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.cantonese: 係囉，溫度好似去到三十七度。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 lo1, wan1 dou6 hou2 ci5 heoi3 dou3 saam1 sap6 cat1 dou6.
sentences.english: I know. The temperature is supposed to reach 37 degrees.

sentences.speaker: Olivia
sentences.cantonese: 希望聽日可以涼返啲啦，我等唔到秋天！
sentences.jyutping: hei1 mong6 ting1 jat6 ho2 ji5 loeng4 faan1 di1 laa1, ngo5 dang2 m4 dou2 cau1 tin1!
sentences.english: I just hope it cools down tomorrow. I can’t wait for fall!

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.cantonese: 但係我聽講之後幾日仲會落大雨添。
sentences.jyutping: daan6 hai6 ngo5 teng1 gong2 zi1 hau6 gei2 jat6 zung6 wui5 lok6 daai6 jyu5 tim1.
sentences.english: But I heard it’s going to rain heavily for the next few days.

sentences.speaker: Olivia
sentences.cantonese: 吓？真係？咁我就要記得帶雨傘啦。
sentences.jyutping: haa2? zan1 hai6? gam2 ngo5 zau6 jiu3 gei3 dak1 daai3 jyu5 saan3 laa1.
sentences.english: What? Really? Then I’d better remember to bring an umbrella.

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，你最好帶件薄褸，以防萬一會凍返轉頭。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, nei5 zeoi3 hou2 daai3 gin6 bok6 lau1, ji5 fong4 maan6 jat1 wui5 dung3 faan1 zyun2 tau4.
sentences.english: Yeah, and maybe a light jacket, just in case it suddenly gets cold again.

sentences.speaker: Olivia
sentences.cantonese: 天氣真係好難捉摸！
sentences.jyutping: tin1 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 zuk1 mo2!
sentences.english: The weather is so unpredictable!

sentences.speaker: Maria
sentences.cantonese: 我哋要買啲咩先？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 maai5 di1 me1 sin1?
sentences.english: What do we need to buy?

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.cantonese: 我哋要牛奶、麵包、同埋雞蛋。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ngau4 naai5, min6 baau1, tung4 maai4 gai1 daan2.
sentences.english: We need milk, bread, and eggs.

sentences.speaker: Maria
sentences.cantonese: 咁仲要買啲水果嗎？
sentences.jyutping: gam2 zung6 jiu3 maai5 di1 seoi2 gwo2 maa3?
sentences.english: Should we get some fruit too?

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，我哋買啲蘋果同香蕉啦。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, ngo5 dei6 maai5 di1 ping4 gwo2 tung4 hoeng1 ziu1 laa1.
sentences.english: Yes, let’s get some apples and bananas.

sentences.speaker: Maria
sentences.cantonese: 你仲需要買肉類嗎？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 zung6 seoi1 jiu3 maai5 juk6 leoi6 maa3?
sentences.english: Do you need to buy any meat?

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.cantonese: 我要買少少雞肉，今晚煮。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 maai5 siu2 siu2 gai1 juk6, gam1 maan5 zyu2.
sentences.english: I want to get some chicken for dinner tonight.

sentences.speaker: Maria
sentences.cantonese: 好呀。咁我哋買完肉就可以去結帳。
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3. gam2 ngo5 dei6 maai5 jyun4 juk6 zau6 ho2 ji5 heoi3 git3 zoeng3.
sentences.english: Okay. After we get the chicken, we can go to the checkout.

sentences.speaker: Sam
sentences.cantonese: 好，我哋快啲啦。今日超市好多人。
sentences.jyutping: hou2, ngo5 dei6 faai3 di1 laa1. gam1 jat6 ciu1 si5 hou2 do1 jan4.
sentences.english: Great. Let’s hurry. The supermarket is really crowded today.

sentences.speaker: Linda
sentences.cantonese: 你今日有冇時間幫我跑幾樣嘢？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 jau5 mou5 si4 gaan3 bong1 ngo5 paau2 gei2 joeng6 je5?
sentences.english: Do you have time today to help me run a few errands?

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.cantonese: 應該可以，你要做啲咩？
sentences.jyutping: jing1 goi1 ho2 ji5, nei5 jiu3 zou6 di1 me1?
sentences.english: I think so. What do you need to do?

sentences.speaker: Linda
sentences.cantonese: 我需要去郵局寄封信，之後要去藥房攞啲藥。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 heoi3 jau4 guk6 gei3 fung1 seon3, zi1 hau6 jiu3 heoi3 joek6 fong4 lo2 di1 joek6.
sentences.english: I need to go to the post office to mail a letter, and then I have to pick up some medicine from the pharmacy.

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.cantonese: 咁我哋可以先去郵局，再去藥房。
sentences.jyutping: gam2 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 sin1 heoi3 jau4 guk6, zoi3 heoi3 joek6 fong4.
sentences.english: Then we can go to the post office first and then to the pharmacy.

sentences.speaker: Linda
sentences.cantonese: 仲有一樣嘢，我哋要順便去超市買啲食物。
sentences.jyutping: zung6 jau5 jat1 joeng6 je5, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 seon6 bin2 heoi3 ciu1 si5 maai5 di1 sik6 mat6.
sentences.english: There’s one more thing—I also need to stop by the supermarket to get some groceries.

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.cantonese: 得呀，我哋可以一齊去。你有冇買嘢清單？
sentences.jyutping: dak1 aa3, ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 jat1 cai4 heoi3. nei5 jau5 mou5 maai5 je5 cing1 daan1?
sentences.english: Sure, we can do all of that together. Do you have a shopping list?

sentences.speaker: Linda
sentences.cantonese: 有呀，就喺我袋入面。多謝你幫手！
sentences.jyutping: jau5 aa3, zau6 hai2 ngo5 doi2 jap6 min6. do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 sau2!
sentences.english: Yes, it’s in my bag. Thanks for helping me!

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.cantonese: 唔使客氣，我哋走啦！
sentences.jyutping: m4 sai2 haak3 hei3, ngo5 dei6 zau2 laa1!
sentences.english: No problem. Let’s get going!

sentences.speaker: Clerk
sentences.cantonese: 你好，需要幫手嗎？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 hou2, seoi1 jiu3 bong1 sau2 maa3?
sentences.english: Hello. May I help you?

sentences.speaker: Susan
sentences.cantonese: 係，我想寄呢個包裹去加拿大。
sentences.jyutping: hai6, ngo5 soeng2 gei3 ni1 go3 baau1 gwo2 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6.
sentences.english: Yes, I’d like to mail this package to Canada.

sentences.speaker: Clerk
sentences.cantonese: 你想用普通郵寄定係快遞？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 jung6 pou2 tung1 jau4 gei3 ding6 hai6 faai3 dai6?
sentences.english: Would you like regular mail or express?

sentences.speaker: Susan
sentences.cantonese: 快遞要幾錢呀？
sentences.jyutping: faai3 dai6 jiu3 gei2 cin2 aa3?
sentences.english: How much is express?

sentences.speaker: Clerk
sentences.cantonese: 大概三十蚊，三日到。
sentences.jyutping: daai6 koi3 saam1 sap6 man1, saam1 jat6 dou3.
sentences.english: About thirty dollars, and it takes three days.

sentences.speaker: Susan
sentences.cantonese: 咁普通郵寄要幾耐先到？
sentences.jyutping: gam2 pou2 tung1 jau4 gei3 jiu3 gei2 noi6 sin1 dou3?
sentences.english: And how long does regular mail take?

sentences.speaker: Clerk
sentences.cantonese: 差唔多要一個星期。
sentences.jyutping: caa1 m4 do1 jiu3 jat1 go3 sing1 kei4.
sentences.english: It takes about a week.

sentences.speaker: Susan
sentences.cantonese: 咁我用普通郵寄啦，多謝你。
sentences.jyutping: gam2 ngo5 jung6 pou2 tung1 jau4 gei3 laa1, do1 ze6 nei5.
sentences.english: Then I’ll use regular mail. Thank you.

sentences.speaker: Clerk
sentences.cantonese: 唔使客氣。請填呢張表格。
sentences.jyutping: m4 sai2 haak3 hei3. cing2 tin4 ni1 zoeng1 biu2 gaak3.
sentences.english: You’re welcome. Please fill out this form.

sentences.speaker: Mia
sentences.cantonese: 嗨，Jason！你覺得今日堂點呀？
sentences.jyutping: haai1, Jason! nei5 gok3 dak1 gam1 jat6 tong4 dim2 aa3?
sentences.english: Hey, Jason! What did you think of today’s class?

sentences.speaker: Jason
sentences.cantonese: 唔錯呀，不過我覺得老師講得好快，我差啲跟唔上。
sentences.jyutping: m4 co3 aa3, bat1 gwo3 ngo5 gok3 dak1 lou5 si1 gong2 dak1 hou2 faai3, ngo5 caa1 di1 gan1 m4 soeng5.
sentences.english: It wasn’t bad, but I think the teacher talked really fast. I could barely keep up.

sentences.speaker: Mia
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，佢今日真係特別快。你做唔做到嗰份練習？
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, keoi5 gam1 jat6 zan1 hai6 dak6 bit6 faai3. nei5 zou6 m4 zou6 dou2 go2 fan6 lin6 zaap6?
sentences.english: Yeah, she was especially fast today. Were you able to finish the exercise?

sentences.speaker: Jason
sentences.cantonese: 做到一半咋。我想返屋企再做。
sentences.jyutping: zou6 dou2 jat1 bun3 zaa3. ngo5 soeng2 faan1 uk1 kei2 zoi3 zou6.
sentences.english: I only got halfway through it. I want to finish it at home.

sentences.speaker: Mia
sentences.cantonese: 如果你要，我可以發我嘅notes畀你。
sentences.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 jiu3, ngo5 ho2 ji5 faat3 ngo5 ge3 notes bei2 nei5.
sentences.english: If you want, I can send you my notes.

sentences.speaker: Jason
sentences.cantonese: 嘩，咁就太好啦！多謝你，Mia！
sentences.jyutping: waa1, gam2 zau6 taai3 hou2 laa1! do1 ze6 nei5, Mia!
sentences.english: Wow, that would be great! Thank you, Mia!

sentences.speaker: Mia
sentences.cantonese: 唔使客氣！你今晚仲有其他功課要做嗎？
sentences.jyutping: m4 sai2 haak3 hei3! nei5 gam1 maan5 zung6 jau5 kei4 taa1 gung1 fo3 jiu3 zou6 maa3?
sentences.english: You’re welcome! Do you have any other homework to do tonight?

sentences.speaker: Jason
sentences.cantonese: 仲有數學同英文。不過應該搞得掂。
sentences.jyutping: zung6 jau5 sou3 hok6 tung4 jing1 man4. bat1 gwo3 jing1 goi1 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
sentences.english: Just math and English. But I think I can finish it.

sentences.speaker: Mia
sentences.cantonese: 好呀，加油！我返屋企先啦。
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3, gaa1 jau2! ngo5 faan1 uk1 kei2 sin1 laa1.
sentences.english: Great, good luck! I’m heading home now.

sentences.speaker: Jason
sentences.cantonese: 好，再見！
sentences.jyutping: hou2, zoi3 gin3!
sentences.english: Okay, see you!

sentences.speaker: Jenny
sentences.cantonese: 你覺得呢件衫點呀？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gin6 saam1 dim2 aa3?
sentences.english: What do you think of this shirt?

sentences.speaker: Laura
sentences.cantonese: 幾好喎，但係好似有啲貴。
sentences.jyutping: gei2 hou2 wo3, daan6 hai6 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 gwai3.
sentences.english: It’s nice, but it seems a bit expensive.

sentences.speaker: Jenny
sentences.cantonese: 係喎，不過佢哋話有八折。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 wo3, bat1 gwo3 keoi5 dei6 waa6 jau5 baat3 zit3.
sentences.english: True, but they said it’s 20% off.

sentences.speaker: Laura
sentences.cantonese: 咁就抵買啦！你想試吓嗎？
sentences.jyutping: gam2 zau6 dai2 maai5 laa1! nei5 soeng2 si3 haa5 maa3?
sentences.english: Then it’s worth it! Do you want to try it on?

sentences.speaker: Jenny
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，我想試吓。更衣室喺邊？
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, ngo5 soeng2 si3 haa5. gang1 ji1 sat1 hai2 bin1?
sentences.english: Yes, I do. Where’s the fitting room?

sentences.speaker: Laura
sentences.cantonese: 喺嗰邊，收銀處隔離。
sentences.jyutping: hai2 go2 bin1, sau1 ngan2 cyu3 gaak3 lei4.
sentences.english: Over there, next to the cashier.

sentences.speaker: Jenny
sentences.cantonese: 我試完啦！你覺得點？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 si3 jyun4 laa1! nei5 gok3 dak1 dim2?
sentences.english: I’m done trying it on! What do you think?

sentences.speaker: Laura
sentences.cantonese: 好啱你喎！顏色同款式都好襯你。
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aam1 nei5 wo3! ngaan4 sik1 tung4 fun2 sik1 dou1 hou2 can3 nei5.
sentences.english: It looks great on you! The color and style really suit you.

sentences.speaker: Jenny
sentences.cantonese: 咁我買啦，多謝你陪我！
sentences.jyutping: gam2 ngo5 maai5 laa1, do1 ze6 nei5 pui4 ngo5!
sentences.english: Then I’ll buy it. Thanks for coming with me!

sentences.speaker: Laura
sentences.cantonese: 唔使客氣！買嘢真係好開心！
sentences.jyutping: m4 sai2 haak3 hei3! maai5 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1!
sentences.english: You’re welcome! Shopping is always fun!

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.cantonese: 你通常點樣返學㗎？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 tung1 soeng4 dim2 joeng6 faan1 hok6 gaa3?
sentences.english: How do you usually get to school?

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.cantonese: 我通常搭巴士，因為我屋企離學校幾遠。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 daap3 baa1 si2, jan1 wai6 ngo5 uk1 kei2 lei4 hok6 haau6 gei2 jyun5.
sentences.english: I usually take the bus because my house is pretty far from school.

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.cantonese: 哦，我就行路返學，只係要十五分鐘。
sentences.jyutping: o4, ngo5 zau6 haang4 lou6 faan1 hok6, zi2 hai6 jiu3 sap6 ng5 fan1 zung1.
sentences.english: Oh, I walk to school. It only takes about fifteen minutes.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.cantonese: 好方便喎！你會唔會有時搭單車返學？
sentences.jyutping: hou2 fong1 bin6 wo3! nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 jau5 si4 daap3 daan1 ce1 faan1 hok6?
sentences.english: That’s convenient! Do you ever ride your bike to school?

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.cantonese: 有呀，天氣好嘅時候我會踩單車。
sentences.jyutping: jau5 aa3, tin1 hei3 hou2 ge3 si4 hau6 ngo5 wui5 caai2 daan1 ce1.
sentences.english: Yeah, I do when the weather is nice.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.cantonese: 我想試吓踩單車返學，但係我有啲驚馬路太繁忙。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 si3 haa5 caai2 daan1 ce1 faan1 hok6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 jau5 di1 geng1 maa5 lou6 taai3 faan4 mong4.
sentences.english: I’d like to try biking to school, but I’m a little afraid the streets are too busy.

sentences.speaker: Alex
sentences.cantonese: 如果你想試，我可以陪你踩一次。
sentences.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 si3, ngo5 ho2 ji5 pui4 nei5 caai2 jat1 ci3.
sentences.english: If you want to try, I can ride with you once.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.cantonese: 好呀，多謝你！咁我哋聽日一齊返學啦！
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3, do1 ze6 nei5! gam2 ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 jat1 cai4 faan1 hok6 laa1!
sentences.english: Great, thank you! Let’s go to school together tomorrow then!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.cantonese: 我哋應該搭的士定係搭巴士去商場？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 daap3 dik1 si2 ding6 hai6 daap3 baa1 si2 heoi3 soeng1 coeng4?
sentences.english: Should we take a taxi or a bus to the mall?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.cantonese: 搭巴士啦。繁忙時間根本截唔到的士。
sentences.jyutping: daap3 baa1 si2 laa1. faan4 mong4 si4 gaan3 gan1 bun2 zit3 m4 dou2 dik1 si2.
sentences.english: Let’s take a bus. It’s impossible to get a taxi during rush hour.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.cantonese: 嗰邊唔係有個巴士站咩？
sentences.jyutping: go2 bin1 m4 hai6 jau5 go3 baa1 si2 zaam6 me1?
sentences.english: Isn’t that a bus stop over there?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.cantonese: 係呀… 哦！巴士嚟啦。我哋要跑先追到。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3... o4! baa1 si2 lei4 laa1. ngo5 dei6 jiu3 paau2 sin1 zeoi1 dou2.
sentences.english: Yes… Oh! There’s a bus now. We’ll have to run to catch it.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.cantonese: 唉唷，唔好啦！我哋啱啱錯過咗。
sentences.jyutping: ai1 joek3, m4 hou2 laa1! ngo5 dei6 aam1 aam1 co3 gwo3 zo2.
sentences.english: Oh, no! We just missed it.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.cantonese: 唔緊要，十分鐘之後仲有一班。
sentences.jyutping: m4 gan2 jiu3, sap6 fan1 zung1 zi1 hau6 zung6 jau5 jat1 baan1.
sentences.english: No problem. There’ll be another one in 10 minutes.

sentences.speaker: Salesperson
sentences.cantonese: 我可以幫你嗎？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 maa3?
sentences.english: Can I help you?

sentences.speaker: Gloria
sentences.cantonese: 可以呀，我想搵一件冷衫——中碼。
sentences.jyutping: ho2 ji5 aa3, ngo5 soeng2 wan2 jat1 gin6 laang5 saam1 — zung1 maa5.
sentences.english: Yes, I’m looking for a sweater — in a size medium.

sentences.speaker: Salesperson
sentences.cantonese: 睇吓先… 呢件白色嘅幾靚喎，你覺得點？
sentences.jyutping: tai2 haa5 sin1... ni1 gin6 baak6 sik1 ge3 gei2 leng3 wo3, nei5 gok3 dak1 dim2?
sentences.english: Let’s see… here’s a nice white one. What do you think?

sentences.speaker: Gloria
sentences.cantonese: 我想要藍色多啲。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 laam4 sik1 do1 di1.
sentences.english: I think I’d rather have it in blue.

sentences.speaker: Salesperson
sentences.cantonese: 好呀… 呢度有藍色，中碼。你想試吓嗎？
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3... ni1 dou6 jau5 laam4 sik1, zung1 maa5. nei5 soeng2 si3 haa5 maa3?
sentences.english: OK… here’s blue, in a medium. Would you like to try it on?

sentences.speaker: Gloria
sentences.cantonese: 好呀… 嘩，我好鍾意！啱啱好，幾啱身形。
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3... waa1, ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3! aam1 aam1 hou2, gei2 aam1 san1 jing4.
sentences.english: OK… yes, I love it. It fits perfectly.

sentences.speaker: Gloria
sentences.cantonese: 幾錢呀？
sentences.jyutping: gei2 cin2 aa3?
sentences.english: How much is it?

sentences.speaker: Salesperson
sentences.cantonese: 五十蚊，加埋稅就五十三蚊。
sentences.jyutping: ng5 sap6 man1, gaa1 maai4 seoi3 zau6 ng5 sap6 saam1 man1.
sentences.english: It’s $50. It will be $53, with tax.

sentences.speaker: Gloria
sentences.cantonese: 好！我要呢件。
sentences.jyutping: hou2! ngo5 jiu3 ni1 gin6.
sentences.english: Perfect! I’ll take it.

sentences.speaker: Linda
sentences.cantonese: 喂！你嘅物理考試考成點呀？
sentences.jyutping: wai3! nei5 ge3 mat6 lei5 haau2 si3 haau2 sing4 dim2 aa3?
sentences.english: Hey! How did your physics exam go?

sentences.speaker: Frank
sentences.cantonese: 都唔差，多謝。我而家只係覺得終於完咗好開心！你呢…你嘅報告做成點？
sentences.jyutping: dou1 m4 caa1, do1 ze6. ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zi2 hai6 gok3 dak1 zung1 jyu1 jyun4 zo2 hou2 hoi1 sam1! nei5 ne1... nei5 ge3 bou3 gou3 zou6 sing4 dim2?
sentences.english: Not bad, thanks. I’m just glad it’s over! How about you… how’d your presentation go?

sentences.speaker: Linda
sentences.cantonese: 哦，做得好好呀。多謝你幫我準備！
sentences.jyutping: o4, zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2 aa3. do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 zeon2 bei6!
sentences.english: Oh, it went really well. Thanks for helping me with it!

sentences.speaker: Frank
sentences.cantonese: 唔使客氣。咁…聽日想唔想一齊溫習數學？
sentences.jyutping: m4 sai2 haak3 hei3. gam2... ting1 jat6 soeng2 m4 soeng2 jat1 cai4 wan1 zaap6 sou3 hok6?
sentences.english: No problem. So… do you feel like studying tomorrow for our math exam?

sentences.speaker: Linda
sentences.cantonese: 好呀，冇問題！十點過嚟啦，食完早餐之後。
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3, mou5 man6 tai4! sap6 dim2 gwo3 lei4 laa1, sik6 jyun4 zou2 caan1 zi1 hau6.
sentences.english: Yeah, sure! Come over around 10:00, after breakfast.

sentences.speaker: Frank
sentences.cantonese: 好，冇問題。我帶埋我嘅筆記。
sentences.jyutping: hou2, mou5 man6 tai4. ngo5 daai3 maai4 ngo5 ge3 bat1 gei3.
sentences.english: All right. I’ll bring my notes.

sentences.speaker: Postal Clerk
sentences.cantonese: 今日我可以幫到你啲乜嘢？
sentences.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ngo5 ho2 ji5 bong1 dou2 nei5 di1 mat1 je5?
sentences.english: What can I do for you today?

sentences.speaker: Carol
sentences.cantonese: 我想寄呢個包裹去紐約，唔該。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 gei3 ni1 go3 baau1 gwo2 heoi3 nau2 joek3, m4 goi1.
sentences.english: I need to mail this package to New York, please.

sentences.speaker: Postal Clerk
sentences.cantonese: 好，睇吓有幾重先……大概五磅。如果你寄特快，聽日就到。或者寄優先郵遞，星期六會到。
sentences.jyutping: hou2, tai2 haa5 jau5 gei2 cung5 sin1... daai6 koi3 ng5 bong6. jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gei3 dak6 faai3, ting1 jat6 zau6 dou3. waak6 ze2 gei3 jau1 sin1 jau4 dai6, sing1 kei4 luk6 wui5 dou3.
sentences.english: OK, let’s see how much it weighs… it’s about five pounds. If you send it express, it will get there tomorrow. Or you can send it priority and it will get there by Saturday.

sentences.speaker: Carol
sentences.cantonese: 星期六到就可以啦。幾錢？
sentences.jyutping: sing1 kei4 luk6 dou3 zau6 ho2 ji5 laa1. gei2 cin2?
sentences.english: Saturday is fine. How much will that be?

sentences.speaker: Postal Clerk
sentences.cantonese: $11.35。你仲需要其他嘢嗎？
sentences.jyutping: sap6 jat1 man1 saam1 sap6 ng5. nei5 zung6 seoi1 jiu3 kei4 taa1 je5 maa3?
sentences.english: $11.35. Do you need anything else?

sentences.speaker: Carol
sentences.cantonese: 哦，係喎，我差啲唔記得。我仲要一本郵票。
sentences.jyutping: o4, hai6 wo3, ngo5 caa1 di1 m4 gei3 dak1. ngo5 zung6 jiu3 jat1 bun2 jau4 piu3.
sentences.english: Oh, yeah! I almost forgot. I need a book of stamps, too.

sentences.speaker: Postal Clerk
sentences.cantonese: 好，你嘅總數係$20.35。
sentences.jyutping: hou2, nei5 ge3 zung2 sou3 hai6 ji6 sap6 man1 saam1 sap6 ng5.
sentences.english: OK, your total comes to $20.35.

sentences.speaker: Hotel Receptionist
sentences.cantonese: 你好，有咩可以幫到你？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 hou2, jau5 me1 ho2 ji5 bong1 dou2 nei5?
sentences.english: Hi, there. How can I help you?

sentences.speaker: Claire
sentences.cantonese: 我嚟到呢度玩幾日，但係都要搞幾樣嘢。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 lei4 dou3 ni1 dou6 waan2 gei2 jat6, daan6 hai6 dou1 jiu3 gaau2 gei2 joeng6 je5.
sentences.english: Well, I’m in town visiting for a few days, and I need to get some things done while I’m here.

sentences.speaker: Hotel Receptionist
sentences.cantonese: 冇問題，你需要啲乜嘢？
sentences.jyutping: mou5 man6 tai4, nei5 seoi1 jiu3 di1 mat1 je5?
sentences.english: Sure. What do you need?

sentences.speaker: Claire
sentences.cantonese: 我想剪頭髮，仲有我要整短條新褲嘅褲腳。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zin2 tau4 faat3, zung6 jau5 ngo5 jiu3 zing2 dyun2 tiu4 san1 fu3 ge3 fu3 goek3.
sentences.english: I need to get my hair cut. I also need to have my new pants hemmed.

sentences.speaker: Hotel Receptionist
sentences.cantonese: 好，呢度有張地圖。呢度有間好好嘅髮型屋，就喺前面一個街口。仲有間裁縫店就喺呢度。仲有冇其他嘢？
sentences.jyutping: hou2, ni1 dou6 jau5 zoeng1 dei6 tou4. ni1 dou6 jau5 gaan1 hou2 hou2 ge3 faat3 jing4 uk1, zau6 hai2 cin4 min6 jat1 go3 gaai1 hau2. zung6 jau5 gaan1 coi4 fung4 dim3 zau6 hai2 ni1 dou6. zung6 jau5 mou5 kei4 taa1 je5?
sentences.english: OK. Here’s a map of the city. There’s a good hair salon here, which is just a block away. And there’s a tailor right here. Is there anything else?

sentences.speaker: Claire
sentences.cantonese: 有呀。我返屋企之前仲要送架車去做檢查。
sentences.jyutping: jau5 aa3. ngo5 faan1 uk1 kei2 zi1 cin4 zung6 jiu3 sung3 gaa3 ce1 heoi3 zou6 gim2 caa4.
sentences.english: Yes. I’ll need to have my car serviced before my long drive home!

sentences.speaker: Hotel Receptionist
sentences.cantonese: 冇問題。附近幾條街之外有個好嘅車房。
sentences.jyutping: mou5 man6 tai4. fu6 gan6 gei2 tiu4 gaai1 zi1 ngoi6 jau5 go3 hou2 ge3 ce1 fong4.
sentences.english: No problem. There’s a good mechanic a few blocks away.

sentences.speaker: Louise
sentences.cantonese: 喂，Julia…睇吓嗰啲甜品！今日焗曲奇好唔好呀？
sentences.jyutping: wai3, Julia... tai2 haa5 go2 di1 tim4 ban2! gam1 jat6 guk6 kuk1 kei4 hou2 m4 hou2 aa3?
sentences.english: Hey, Julia… Look at those desserts! How about baking some cookies today?

sentences.speaker: Julia
sentences.cantonese: 唔…好呀，呢個主意好正！既然嚟到超市，順便買埋材料啦。
sentences.jyutping: m4... hou2 aa3, ni1 go3 zyu2 ji3 hou2 zing3! gei3 jin4 lei4 dou3 ciu1 si5, seon6 bin2 maai5 maai4 coi2 liu4 laa1.
sentences.english: Hmm… Yeah, that’s a great idea! While we’re here, let’s pick up the ingredients.

sentences.speaker: Louise
sentences.cantonese: 好呀，我哋要啲乜嘢？
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 di1 mat1 je5?
sentences.english: OK, what do we need?

sentences.speaker: Julia
sentences.cantonese: 食譜話要麵粉、糖同牛油。哦，仲要雞蛋同朱古力粒。
sentences.jyutping: sik6 pou2 waa6 jiu3 min6 fan2, tong4 tung4 ngau4 jau4. o4, zung6 jiu3 gai1 daan2 tung4 zyu1 gu1 lik1 nap1.
sentences.english: The recipe calls for flour, sugar and butter. Oh, and we also need eggs and chocolate chips.

sentences.speaker: Louise
sentences.cantonese: 不如你去攞奶類嗰啲嘢啦？喺後面嘅雪櫃區。乾貨我去攞啦——喺十號通道。
sentences.jyutping: bat1 jyu4 nei5 heoi3 lo2 naai5 leoi6 go2 di1 je5 laa1? hai2 hau6 min6 ge3 syut3 kwai6 keoi1. gon1 fo3 ngo5 heoi3 lo2 laa1 — hai2 sap6 hou6 tung1 dou6.
sentences.english: Why don’t you get the dairy ingredients? You’ll find those in the refrigerated section in the back of the store. I’ll get the dry ingredients — they’re in aisle 10.

sentences.speaker: Julia
sentences.cantonese: 好呀！咁我哋喺收銀度見啦。
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3! gam2 ngo5 dei6 hai2 sau1 ngan2 dou6 gin3 laa1.
sentences.english: Great! Let’s meet at the checkout.

sentences.speaker: Louise
sentences.cantonese: 好，待會見。
sentences.jyutping: hou2, doi6 wui2 gin3.
sentences.english: OK. See you there.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.cantonese: 喂！嗰架車剛剛衝紅燈撞到嗰架貨車！
sentences.jyutping: wai3! go2 gaa3 ce1 gong1 gong1 cung1 hung4 dang1 zong6 dou2 go2 gaa3 fo3 ce1!
sentences.english: Hey! That car just ran a red light and hit that truck!

sentences.speaker: Gail
sentences.cantonese: 有冇人受傷呀？
sentences.jyutping: jau5 mou5 jan4 sau6 soeng1 aa3?
sentences.english: Is anyone hurt?

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.cantonese: 我唔清楚… 我哋打911啦。… 喂？我想報告一單交通意外，就喺Charles Street郵局附近。好似有個男人受傷。係，啱啱發生。好，多謝，再見。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 m4 cing1 co2... ngo5 dei6 daa2 gau2 jat1 jat1 jat1 laa1. ... wai3? ngo5 soeng2 bou3 gou3 jat1 daan1 gaau1 tung1 ji3 ngo6, zau6 hai2 Charles Street jau4 guk6 fu6 gan6. hou2 ci5 jau5 go3 naam4 jan4 sau6 soeng1. hai6, aam1 aam1 faat3 sang1. hou2, do1 ze6, zoi3 gin3.
sentences.english: I don’t know… let’s call 911. … Hello? I’d like to report a car accident near the post office on Charles Street. It looks like a man is hurt. Yes, it just happened. OK, thanks. Bye.

sentences.speaker: Gail
sentences.cantonese: 佢哋點講？
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 dim2 gong2?
sentences.english: What did they say?

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.cantonese: 佢哋會即刻派救護車同差人車過嚟。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 wui5 zik1 hak1 paai3 gau3 wu6 ce1 tung4 caai1 jan4 ce1 gwo3 lei4.
sentences.english: They’re going to send an ambulance and a police car right away.

sentences.speaker: Gail
sentences.cantonese: 好，佢哋嚟到啦。我希望個男人冇事啦。
sentences.jyutping: hou2, keoi5 dei6 lei4 dou3 laa1. ngo5 hei1 mong6 go3 naam4 jan4 mou5 si6 laa1.
sentences.english: Good, they’re here. I hope the man is OK.

sentences.speaker: Peter
sentences.cantonese: 係呀。開車真係要好小心。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3. hoi1 ce1 zan1 hai6 jiu3 hou2 siu2 sam1.
sentences.english: I know. You have to be so careful when you’re driving.

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.cantonese: 唔好意思，你可唔可以同我講圖書館喺邊度？
sentences.jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 ngo5 gong2 tou4 syu1 gun2 hai2 bin1 dou6?
sentences.english: Excuse me. Could you tell me where the library is?

sentences.speaker: Nancy
sentences.cantonese: 可以呀，向嗰邊走。行三個街口到Washington Street，之後轉右。圖書館就喺個街角，銀行對面。
sentences.jyutping: ho2 ji5 aa3, hoeng3 go2 bin1 zau2. haang4 saam1 go3 gaai1 hau2 dou3 Washington Street, zi1 hau6 zyun3 jau6. tou4 syu1 gun2 zau6 hai2 go3 gaai1 gok3, ngon4 hong4 deoi3 min6.
sentences.english: Yes, it’s that way. You go three blocks to Washington Street, then turn right. It’s on the corner, across from the bank.

sentences.speaker: Mark
sentences.cantonese: 多謝！我啱啱先嚟到呢個城市幾日，所以仲唔係好熟路。
sentences.jyutping: do1 ze6! ngo5 aam1 aam1 sin1 lei4 dou3 ni1 go3 sing4 si5 gei2 jat6, so2 ji5 zung6 m4 hai6 hou2 suk6 lou6.
sentences.english: Thanks! I’ve only been in town a few days, so I really don’t know my way around yet.

sentences.speaker: Nancy
sentences.cantonese: 哦，我明白你嘅感受。我哋搬嚟嘅時候都係咁。
sentences.jyutping: o4, ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 ge3 gam2 sau6. ngo5 dei6 bun1 lei4 ge3 si4 hau6 dou1 hai6 gam2.
sentences.english: Oh, I know how you feel. We moved here and felt the same way.

sentences.speaker: Doctor
sentences.cantonese: 你覺得有咩問題？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 gok3 dak1 jau5 me1 man6 tai4?
sentences.english: What seems to be the problem?

sentences.speaker: Cathy
sentences.cantonese: 嗯，我咳得好厲害，喉嚨又痛，仲有頭痛。
sentences.jyutping: ng6, ngo5 kat1 dak1 hou2 lai6 hoi6, hau4 lung4 jau6 tung3, zung6 jau5 tau4 tung3.
sentences.english: Well, I have a bad cough and a sore throat. I also have a headache.

sentences.speaker: Doctor
sentences.cantonese: 你有呢啲症狀幾耐啦？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 jau5 ni1 di1 zing3 zong6 gei2 noi6 laa1?
sentences.english: How long have you had these symptoms?

sentences.speaker: Cathy
sentences.cantonese: 差唔多三日啦，而且我好攰。
sentences.jyutping: caa1 m4 do1 saam1 jat6 laa1, ji4 ce2 ngo5 hou2 gui6.
sentences.english: About three days now. And I’m really tired, too.

sentences.speaker: Doctor
sentences.cantonese: 嗯，聽落好似係流感。四個鐘頭食一次阿士匹靈，多啲休息，記住飲多啲水。如果下星期仲未好，打畀我。
sentences.jyutping: ng6, teng1 lok6 hou2 ci5 hai6 lau4 gam2. sei3 go3 zung1 tau4 sik6 jat1 ci3 aa3 si6 pat1 ling4, do1 di1 jau1 sik1, gei3 zyu6 jam2 do1 di1 seoi2. jyu4 gwo2 haa6 sing1 kei4 zung6 mei6 hou2, daa2 bei2 ngo5.
sentences.english: Hmm. It sounds like you’ve got the flu. Take aspirin every four hours and get plenty of rest. Make sure you drink lots of fluids. Call me if you’re still sick next week.

sentences.speaker: Cathy
sentences.cantonese: 好，多謝醫生。
sentences.jyutping: hou2, do1 ze6 ji1 sang1.
sentences.english: OK, thanks.

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.cantonese: 你好，我會係今日嘅服務員。想先飲啲咩？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 hou2, ngo5 wui5 hai6 gam1 jat6 ge3 fuk6 mou6 jyun4. soeng2 sin1 jam2 di1 me1?
sentences.english: Hello, I’ll be your waiter today. Can I start you off with something to drink?

sentences.speaker: Ralph
sentences.cantonese: 要，麻煩畀我一杯凍茶。
sentences.jyutping: jiu3, maa4 faan4 bei2 ngo5 jat1 bui1 dung3 caa4.
sentences.english: Yes. I’ll have iced tea, please.

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.cantonese: 我要檸檬水。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 ning4 mung1 seoi2.
sentences.english: And I’ll have lemonade.

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.cantonese: 好。你哋準備好落單未？定係要多幾分鐘？
sentences.jyutping: hou2. nei5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2 lok6 daan1 mei6? ding6 hai6 jiu3 do1 gei2 fan1 zung1?
sentences.english: OK. Are you ready to order, or do you need a few minutes?

sentences.speaker: Ralph
sentences.cantonese: 我諗我哋準備好啦。我想要番茄湯做頭盤，之後要烤牛肉，配薯蓉同豌豆。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 lam2 ngo5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2 laa1. ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 faan1 ke2 tong1 zou6 tau4 pun2, zi1 hau6 jiu3 haau1 ngau4 juk6, pui3 syu4 jung4 tung4 wun1 dau6.
sentences.english: I think we’re ready. I’ll have the tomato soup to start, and the roast beef with mashed potatoes and peas.

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.cantonese: 你想烤牛肉幾成熟？一成熟、半成熟，定係全熟？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 haau1 ngau4 juk6 gei2 sing4 suk6? jat1 sing4 suk6, bun3 sing4 suk6, ding6 hai6 cyun4 suk6?
sentences.english: How do you want the beef — rare, medium, or well done?

sentences.speaker: Ralph
sentences.cantonese: 全熟，唔該。
sentences.jyutping: cyun4 suk6, m4 goi1.
sentences.english: Well done, please.

sentences.speaker: Anna
sentences.cantonese: 而我就要魚，加薯仔同沙律。
sentences.jyutping: ji4 ngo5 zau6 jiu3 jyu2, gaa1 syu4 zai2 tung4 saa1 leot6.
sentences.english: And I’ll just have the fish, with potatoes and a salad.

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.cantonese: 你今年幾多歲呀？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 gam1 nin4 gei2 do1 seoi3 aa3?
sentences.english: How old are you this year?

sentences.speaker: Lucas
sentences.cantonese: 我今年二十歲，你呢？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 nin4 ji6 sap6 seoi3, nei5 ne1?
sentences.english: I’m twenty this year. How about you?

sentences.speaker: Emma
sentences.cantonese: 我十九歲，差唔多啦。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 sap6 gau2 seoi3, caa1 m4 do1 laa1.
sentences.english: I’m nineteen. Almost the same.

sentences.speaker: Lucas
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，我哋都係同一代人。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 tung4 jat1 doi6 jan4.
sentences.english: Yeah, we’re basically the same generation.

sentences.speaker: Kevin
sentences.cantonese: 你睇過呢套新戲未？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 tai2 gwo3 ni1 tou3 san1 hei3 mei6?
sentences.english: Have you seen this new movie yet?

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.cantonese: 未呀，不過聽講好好睇。
sentences.jyutping: mei6 aa3, bat1 gwo3 teng1 gong2 hou2 hou2 tai2.
sentences.english: Not yet, but I’ve heard it’s really good.

sentences.speaker: Kevin
sentences.cantonese: 咁我哋買七點嗰場啦？
sentences.jyutping: gam2 ngo5 dei6 maai5 cat1 dim2 go2 coeng4 laa1?
sentences.english: Then should we get tickets for the 7 pm showing?

sentences.speaker: Nora
sentences.cantonese: 好呀，買埋爆谷啦！
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3, maai5 maai4 baau3 guk1 laa1!
sentences.english: Sure—and let’s get popcorn too!

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.cantonese: 你覺得自己最叻啲乜嘢？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 zeoi3 lek1 di1 mat1 je5?
sentences.english: What do you think you're best at?

sentences.speaker: Daniel
sentences.cantonese: 我打籃球幾叻㗎，你呢？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 daa2 laam4 kau4 gei2 lek1 gaa3, nei5 ne1?
sentences.english: I’m pretty good at basketball. How about you?

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.cantonese: 我就叻彈琴，多數係幫學校表演。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zau6 lek1 taan4 kam4, do1 sou3 hai6 bong1 hok6 haau6 biu2 jin2.
sentences.english: I’m good at playing the piano. I usually perform for school events.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.cantonese: 你最鍾意邊種運動？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 bin1 zung2 wan6 dung6?
sentences.english: What’s your favorite sport?

sentences.speaker: Holly
sentences.cantonese: 我最鍾意游水，夏天成日去泳池。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 jau4 seoi2, haa6 tin1 seng4 jat6 heoi3 wing6 ci4.
sentences.english: I love swimming. I go to the pool all the time in the summer.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.cantonese: 我鍾意跑步，感覺好放鬆。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 paau2 bou6, gam2 gok3 hou2 fong3 sung1.
sentences.english: I like running. It helps me relax.

sentences.speaker: Megan
sentences.cantonese: 呢套舞台劇真係好精彩！
sentences.jyutping: ni1 tou3 mou5 toi4 kek6 zan1 hai6 hou2 zing1 coi2!
sentences.english: This stage play is really amazing!

sentences.speaker: Grant
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，演員演得好投入。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, jin2 jyun4 jin2 dak1 hou2 tau4 jap6.
sentences.english: Yeah, the actors are really into it.

sentences.speaker: Megan
sentences.cantonese: 我好期待下一幕。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 kei4 doi6 haa6 jat1 mok6.
sentences.english: I can’t wait for the next scene.

sentences.speaker: Olivia
sentences.cantonese: 你暑假有冇打算去邊度玩？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 syu2 gaa3 jau5 mou5 daa2 syun3 heoi3 bin1 dou6 waan2?
sentences.english: Do you have any plans for summer vacation?

sentences.speaker: Ben
sentences.cantonese: 我想去台灣食嘢同行山。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 toi4 waan1 sik6 je5 tung4 haang4 saan1.
sentences.english: I’m thinking of going to Taiwan for food and hiking.

sentences.speaker: Olivia
sentences.cantonese: 嘩，正呀！記住影多啲相返嚟。
sentences.jyutping: waa1, zing3 aa3! gei3 zyu6 jing2 do1 di1 soeng2 faan1 lei4.
sentences.english: Wow, nice! Remember to bring back lots of photos.

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.cantonese: 你覺得買邊種寵物好？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 gok3 dak1 maai5 bin1 zung2 cung2 mat6 hou2?
sentences.english: What kind of pet do you think I should get?

sentences.speaker: Ethan
sentences.cantonese: 如果你想容易照顧，可以養倉鼠。
sentences.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 jung6 ji2 ziu3 gu3, ho2 ji5 joeng5 cong1 syu2.
sentences.english: If you want something easy to care for, you could get a hamster.

sentences.speaker: Chloe
sentences.cantonese: 但我鍾意狗呀。或者收養一隻流浪狗都得。
sentences.jyutping: daan6 ngo5 zung1 ji3 gau2 aa3. waak6 ze2 sau1 joeng5 jat1 zek3 lau4 long6 gau2 dou1 dak1.
sentences.english: But I love dogs. Maybe I could adopt a stray dog.

sentences.speaker: Nate
sentences.cantonese: 你覺得今次嘅活動好唔好？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 gok3 dak1 gam1 ci3 ge3 wut6 dung6 hou2 m4 hou2?
sentences.english: What do you think of this event?

sentences.speaker: Iris
sentences.cantonese: 我覺得好有趣，不過有啲嘈。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 jau5 ceoi3, bat1 gwo3 jau5 di1 cou4.
sentences.english: I think it’s interesting, but a little noisy.

sentences.speaker: Nate
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，人太多啦。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, jan4 taai3 do1 laa1.
sentences.english: Yeah, there are too many people.

sentences.speaker: Harper
sentences.cantonese: 你平時鍾意做啲乜嘢消遣？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 ping4 si4 zung1 ji3 zou6 di1 mat1 je5 siu1 hin2?
sentences.english: What do you like to do for fun?

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.cantonese: 我鍾意畫畫，你呢？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 waak6 waa2, nei5 ne1?
sentences.english: I like drawing. What about you?

sentences.speaker: Harper
sentences.cantonese: 我最鍾意煮嘢食，同朋友試新食譜。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 zyu2 je5 sik6, tung4 pang4 jau5 si3 san1 sik6 pou2.
sentences.english: I love cooking and trying new recipes with friends.

sentences.speaker: Ella
sentences.cantonese: 你聽日會唔會去婚禮？
sentences.jyutping: nei5 ting1 jat6 wui5 m4 wui5 heoi3 fan1 lai5?
sentences.english: Are you going to the wedding tomorrow?

sentences.speaker: Mason
sentences.cantonese: 會呀，我係伴郎之一。
sentences.jyutping: wui5 aa3, ngo5 hai6 bun6 long4 zi1 jat1.
sentences.english: Yes, I’m one of the groomsmen.

sentences.speaker: Ella
sentences.cantonese: 嘩，咁就要打扮得靚啲啦！
sentences.jyutping: waa1, gam2 zau6 jiu3 daa2 baan6 dak1 leng3 di1 laa1!
sentences.english: Wow, then you need to dress nicely!

sentences.speaker: Tina
sentences.cantonese: 我最近壓力好大，點算好？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6, dim2 syun3 hou2?
sentences.english: I’ve been really stressed lately. What should I do?

sentences.speaker: Marlon
sentences.cantonese: 不如試吓做運動，或者搵時間休息吓。
sentences.jyutping: bat1 jyu4 si3 haa5 zou6 wan6 dung6, waak6 ze2 wan2 si4 gaan3 jau1 sik1 haa5.
sentences.english: Try exercising, or find some time to rest.

sentences.speaker: Tina
sentences.cantonese: 係喎，我應該安排吓自己。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 wo3, ngo5 jing1 goi1 on1 paai4 haa5 zi6 gei2.
sentences.english: You’re right. I should take better care of myself.

sentences.speaker: Patty
sentences.cantonese: 我好期待今日下午Mary阿姨嘅驚喜生日會！你係咪都好興奮？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 kei4 doi6 gam1 jat6 haa6 ng5 Mary aa3 ji1 ge3 ging1 hei2 saang1 jat6 wui2! nei5 hai6 mai6 dou1 hou2 hing1 fan5?
sentences.english: I’m really excited for Aunt Mary’s surprise birthday party this afternoon! Aren’t you?

sentences.speaker: Susan
sentences.cantonese: 係呀！佢今年幾多歲呀？
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3! keoi5 gam1 nin4 gei2 do1 seoi3 aa3?
sentences.english: Yeah! How old is she?

sentences.speaker: Patty
sentences.cantonese: 佢五月十四號就五十五歲啦。
sentences.jyutping: keoi5 ng5 jyut6 sap6 sei3 hou6 zau6 ng5 sap6 ng5 seoi3 laa1.
sentences.english: She’ll be 55 on May 14.

sentences.speaker: Susan
sentences.cantonese: 嘩！我都唔知原來我媽仲大啲——佢九月二號就五十七歲啦。無論點，Mary阿姨見到我哋一定好驚喜！
sentences.jyutping: waa1! ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 jyun4 loi4 ngo5 maa1 zung6 daai6 di1 — keoi5 gau2 jyut6 ji6 hou6 zau6 ng5 sap6 cat1 seoi3 laa1. mou4 leon6 dim2, Mary aa3 ji1 gin3 dou2 ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 hou2 ging1 hei2!
sentences.english: Wow! I didn’t know that my mom was older — she’s going to be 57 on September 2. Anyway, Aunt Mary’s going to be so surprised to see us all here!

sentences.speaker: Patty
sentences.cantonese: 係呀！但佢未到之前我哋要快啲擺好啲食物。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3! daan6 keoi5 mei6 dou3 zi1 cin4 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 faai3 di1 baai2 hou2 di1 sik6 mat6.
sentences.english: I know! But we still have to get all the food set up before she gets here…

sentences.speaker: All
sentences.cantonese: 好啦！我哋準備好啦。噤聲！佢到啦！
sentences.jyutping: hou2 laa1! ngo5 dei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2 laa1. sam1! keoi5 dou3 laa1!
sentences.english: OK! We’re all ready now. Shh! She’s here!

sentences.speaker: All
sentences.cantonese: 驚喜！
sentences.jyutping: ging1 hei2!
sentences.english: Surprise!

sentences.speaker: Bob
sentences.cantonese: 我哋想買三點半嗰場嘅兩張飛，唔該。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 maai5 saam1 dim2 bun3 go2 coeng4 ge3 loeng5 zoeng1 fei1, m4 goi1.
sentences.english: We’d like two tickets for the 3:30 show, please.

sentences.speaker: Ticket Sales
sentences.cantonese: 畀你哋，請慢慢欣賞套戲！
sentences.jyutping: bei2 nei5 dei6, cing2 maan6 maan6 jan1 soeng5 tou3 hei3!
sentences.english: Here you go. Enjoy the movie!

sentences.speaker: Bob
sentences.cantonese: 唔該，你可唔可以移開一個位，等我同朋友可以坐埋一齊？
sentences.jyutping: m4 goi1, nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ji4 hoi1 jat1 go3 wai2, dang2 ngo5 tung4 pang4 jau5 ho2 ji5 co5 maai4 jat1 cai4?
sentences.english: Would you mind moving over one, so my friend and I can sit together?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.cantonese: 唔介意呀。
sentences.jyutping: m4 gaai3 ji3 aa3.
sentences.english: No, not at all.

sentences.speaker: Bob
sentences.cantonese: 多謝晒！
sentences.jyutping: do1 ze6 saai3!
sentences.english: Thanks a lot!

sentences.speaker: Sandra
sentences.cantonese: 咁……我哋做啲乜好呢？
sentences.jyutping: gam2… ngo5 dei6 zou6 di1 mat1 hou2 ne1?
sentences.english: So… what should we do?

sentences.speaker: Julie
sentences.cantonese: 嗯，我鍾意手作，又好叻畫畫。你覺得點？
sentences.jyutping: ng6, ngo5 zung1 ji3 sau2 zok3, jau6 hou2 lek1 waak6 waa2. nei5 gok3 dak1 dim2?
sentences.english: Well, I like to do arts and crafts, and I’m really good at drawing. What do you think?

sentences.speaker: Sandra
sentences.cantonese: 嗯……玩桌上遊戲點呀？咁會好玩啲。
sentences.jyutping: ng6… waan2 coek3 soeng6 jau4 hei3 dim2 aa3? gam2 wui5 hou2 waan2 di1.
sentences.english: Hmm… how about playing a board game? That would be more fun.

sentences.speaker: Julie
sentences.cantonese: 好啊。玩拼字遊戲啦！我拼字都好叻㗎！
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3. waan2 ping3 zi6 jau4 hei3 laa1! ngo5 ping3 zi6 dou1 hou2 lek1 gaa3!
sentences.english: OK. Let’s play Scrabble! I’m really good at spelling, too!

sentences.speaker: Sandra
sentences.cantonese: 係咩？咁就睇下你有幾叻啦！
sentences.jyutping: hai6 me1? gam2 zau6 tai2 haa5 nei5 jau5 gei2 lek1 laa1!
sentences.english: Oh yeah? We’ll see about that!

sentences.speaker: Phil
sentences.cantonese: 嗰場足球比賽幾點開始呀？我以為中午十二點開波㗎。
sentences.jyutping: go2 coeng4 zuk1 kau4 bei2 coi3 gei2 dim2 hoi1 ci2 aa3? ngo5 ji5 wai4 zung1 ng5 sap6 ji6 dim2 hoi1 bo1 gaa3.
sentences.english: What time is that soccer game on? I thought it started at noon.

sentences.speaker: Jack
sentences.cantonese: 我哋應該記錯時間啦。不過都好啦，我本身都唔係好鍾意足球，我更鍾意籃球。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 gei3 co3 si4 gaan3 laa1. bat1 gwo3 dou1 hou2 laa1, ngo5 bun2 san1 dou1 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 zuk1 kau4, ngo5 gang1 zung1 ji3 laam4 kau4.
sentences.english: We must have had the wrong time. Oh well… soccer’s not my favorite sport anyway. I much prefer basketball.

sentences.speaker: Phil
sentences.cantonese: 係咩？我以為你最鍾意網球添！我都好鍾意籃球㗎。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 me1? ngo5 ji5 wai4 nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 mong5 kau4 tim1! ngo5 dou1 hou2 zung1 ji3 laam4 kau4 gaa3.
sentences.english: Oh, really? I thought your favorite sport was tennis! I’m a big fan of basketball too.

sentences.speaker: Jack
sentences.cantonese: 咁遲啲打一場點呀？
sentences.jyutping: gam2 ci4 di1 daa2 jat1 coeng4 dim2 aa3?
sentences.english: How about a game sometime?

sentences.speaker: Phil
sentences.cantonese: 冇問題！既然足球比賽無得睇，不如下而家去投籃啦？
sentences.jyutping: mou5 man6 tai4! gei3 jin4 zuk1 kau4 bei2 coi3 mou4 dak1 tai2, bat1 jyu4 haa6 ji4 gaa1 heoi3 tau4 laam4 laa1?
sentences.english: Sure thing! Why don’t we go shoot some hoops now since the soccer game isn’t on?

sentences.speaker: Jack
sentences.cantonese: 好主意，走啦！
sentences.jyutping: hou2 zyu2 ji3, zau2 laa1!
sentences.english: Excellent idea. Let’s go.

sentences.speaker: Shannon
sentences.cantonese: 真係一場好精彩嘅演出！多謝你邀請我睇呢套音樂劇。
sentences.jyutping: zan1 hai6 jat1 coeng4 hou2 zing1 coi2 ge3 jin2 ceot1! do1 ze6 nei5 jiu1 cing2 ngo5 tai2 ni1 tou3 jam1 ngok6 kek6.
sentences.english: What a fantastic performance! Thank you for inviting me to the musical.

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.cantonese: 唔使客氣。我好開心你鍾意睇。舞蹈員嘅編舞真係精彩到不得了，令我諗起以前我跳舞嘅時候。
sentences.jyutping: m4 sai2 haak3 hei3. ngo5 hou2 hoi1 sam1 nei5 zung1 ji3 tai2. mou5 dou6 jyun4 ge3 pin1 mou2 zan1 hai6 zing1 coi2 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5, ling6 ngo5 lam2 hei2 ji5 cin4 ngo5 tiu3 mou5 ge3 si4 hau6.
sentences.english: You’re welcome. I’m happy you enjoyed the show. The choreography of the dancers was incredible. It reminds me of when I used to dance.

sentences.speaker: Shannon
sentences.cantonese: 我知呀！你以前跳芭蕾舞真係好有天分。你會唔會掛住跳舞？
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 zi1 aa3! nei5 ji5 cin4 tiu3 baa1 leoi4 mou5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 tin1 fan6. nei5 wui5 m4 wui5 gwaa3 zyu6 tiu3 mou5?
sentences.english: I know! You were such a talented ballerina. Do you miss dancing?

sentences.speaker: Elena
sentences.cantonese: 哎呀，Shannon，你咁講好窩心。偶爾我都會掛住，不過我永遠都係藝術嘅粉絲。就係因為咁，我好鍾意睇音樂劇——歌、舞、戲劇集於一身，完美嘅組合。
sentences.jyutping: ai1 jaa3, Shannon, nei5 gam2 gong2 hou2 wo1 sam1. ngau5 ji5 ngo5 dou1 wui5 gwaa3 zyu6, bat1 gwo3 ngo5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 ngai6 seot6 ge3 fan2 si1. zau6 hai6 jan1 wai6 gam2, ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 jam1 ngok6 kek6 — go1, mou5, hei3 kek6 zaap6 jyu1 jat1 san1, jyun4 mei5 ge3 zou2 hap6.
sentences.english: Oh, that’s very kind of you, Shannon. I do miss it sometimes. But I will always be a fan of the arts. That’s why I love going to musicals because it’s the perfect combination of song, dance, and theater.

sentences.speaker: Shannon
sentences.cantonese: 完全認同！我真係好開心你依然咁鍾意藝術。多謝你嘅邀請。每次同你一齊去睇藝術表演，我都會學到新嘢，真係好享受。
sentences.jyutping: jyun4 cyun4 jing6 tung4! ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1 nei5 ji1 jin4 gam3 zung1 ji3 ngai6 seot6. do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 jiu1 cing2. mui5 ci3 tung4 nei5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 ngai6 seot6 biu2 jin2, ngo5 dou1 wui5 hok6 dou2 san1 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 hoeng2 sau6.
sentences.english: Absolutely! I’m glad you are still an art fan too. Thank you for the invitation. It’s always a pleasure to attend an arts event with you and learn something new.

sentences.speaker: Connie
sentences.cantonese: 嘩！呢隻貓好靚呀。你點睇？
sentences.jyutping: waa1! ni1 zek3 maau1 hou2 leng3 aa3. nei5 dim2 tai2?
sentences.english: Oh! What a beautiful cat. What do you think?

sentences.speaker: Gary
sentences.cantonese: 我覺得我寧願養狗。狗比貓忠心啲。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ngo5 ling4 jyun2 joeng5 gau2. gau2 bei2 maau1 zung1 sam1 di1.
sentences.english: I think I’d rather get a dog. Dogs are more loyal than cats.

sentences.speaker: Connie
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，但係照顧狗好麻煩㗎！你肯唔肯每日都帶佢散步？仲要執佢嘅便便？
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, daan6 hai6 ziu3 gu3 gau2 hou2 maa4 faan4 gaa3! nei5 hang2 m4 hang2 mui5 jat6 dou1 daai3 keoi5 saan3 bou6? zung6 jiu3 zap1 keoi5 ge3 bin6 bin6?
sentences.english: Yes, but they’re so much work! Would you be willing to walk it every single day? And clean up after it?

sentences.speaker: Gary
sentences.cantonese: 嗯…講得啱。咁養雀仔點？或者養魚？
sentences.jyutping: ng6… gong2 dak1 aam1. gam2 joeng5 zoek3 zai2 dim2? waak6 ze2 joeng5 jyu2?
sentences.english: Hmm. Good point. What about a bird? Or a fish?

sentences.speaker: Connie
sentences.cantonese: 咁我哋就要花好多錢買籠或者魚缸啦。而且我都唔識點樣照顧雀仔或者魚！
sentences.jyutping: gam2 ngo5 dei6 zau6 jiu3 faa1 hou2 do1 cin2 maai5 lung4 waak6 ze2 jyu2 gong1 laa1. ji4 ce2 ngo5 dou1 m4 sik1 dim2 joeng2 ziu3 gu3 zoek3 zai2 waak6 ze2 jyu2!
sentences.english: We’d have to invest a lot of money in a cage or a fish tank. And I don’t really know how to take care of a bird or a fish!

sentences.speaker: Gary
sentences.cantonese: 睇嚟我哋暫時未準備好養寵物喇。
sentences.jyutping: tai2 lei4 ngo5 dei6 zaam6 si4 mei6 zeon2 bei6 hou2 joeng5 cung2 mat6 laa3.
sentences.english: Well, we’re obviously not ready to get a pet yet.

sentences.speaker: Connie
sentences.cantonese: 你講得啱。不如去飲杯咖啡，再慢慢傾啦。
sentences.jyutping: nei5 gong2 dak1 aam1. bat1 jyu4 heoi3 jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1, zoi3 maan6 maan6 king1 laa1.
sentences.english: Yeah, you’re right. Let’s go grab some coffee and talk about it.

sentences.speaker: Julie
sentences.cantonese: 我啱啱買咗去紐約嘅機票，超級興奮，可以去睇下呢個城市！
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 aam1 aam1 maai5 zo2 heoi3 nau2 joek3 ge3 gei1 piu3, ciu1 kap1 hing1 fan5, ho2 ji5 heoi3 tai2 haa5 ni1 go3 sing4 si5!
sentences.english: I just bought a ticket to New York City. I’m so excited to see the city!

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.cantonese: 好嘢！旅行真係好好玩。我最鍾意發掘新嘅地方同新朋友。你幾時出發？
sentences.jyutping: hou2 je5! leoi5 hang4 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 waan2. ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 faat3 gwat6 san1 ge3 dei6 fong1 tung4 san1 pang4 jau5. nei5 gei2 si4 ceot1 faat3?
sentences.english: Good for you! Traveling is so much fun. I love discovering new places and new people. When are you leaving?

sentences.speaker: Julie
sentences.cantonese: 下個星期。我搭紅眼機，因為平啲。希望我喺飛機上面瞓到啦。
sentences.jyutping: haa6 go3 sing1 kei4. ngo5 daap3 hung4 ngaan5 gei1, jan1 wai6 peng4 di1. hei1 mong6 ngo5 hai2 fei1 gei1 soeng6 min6 fan3 dou2 laa1.
sentences.english: Next week. I’m taking the red eye. It was cheaper. Hopefully, I’ll be able to sleep on the plane.

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.cantonese: 我都想同你一齊去呀！紐約係一個好有魔力嘅地方，你一定會玩得好開心。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dou1 soeng2 tung4 nei5 jat1 cai4 heoi3 aa3! nau2 joek3 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 jau5 mo1 lik6 ge3 dei6 fong1, nei5 jat1 ding6 wui5 waan2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
sentences.english: I wish I could go with you! New York City is a magical place. You will have so much fun.

sentences.speaker: Julie
sentences.cantonese: 希望啦。我會探下喺度住嘅哥哥。我會留一個星期，之後搭火車落去華盛頓。
sentences.jyutping: hei1 mong6 laa1. ngo5 wui5 taam3 haa5 hai2 dou6 zyu6 ge3 go4 go1. ngo5 wui5 lau4 jat1 go3 sing1 kei4, zi1 hau6 daap3 fo2 ce1 lok6 heoi3 waa4 sing6 deon6.
sentences.english: I hope so. I’m going to visit my brother who lives there. I will stay for a week and then take the train down to Washington, D.C.

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.cantonese: 聽落去真係好好嘅假期。我就期待去沙灘度放鬆一個星期，我只係想休息。
sentences.jyutping: teng1 lok6 heoi3 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 ge3 gaa3 kei4. ngo5 zau6 kei4 doi6 heoi3 saa1 taan1 dou6 fong3 sung1 jat1 go3 sing1 kei4, ngo5 zi2 hai6 soeng2 jau1 sik1.
sentences.english: That sounds like a great vacation. I’m looking forward to a week at the beach for my summer vacation. I just want to relax.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.cantonese: 今年我哋應該去邊度度假呢？不如快啲決定啦。
sentences.jyutping: gam1 nin4 ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 heoi3 bin1 dou6 dou6 gaa3 ne1? bat1 jyu4 faai3 di1 kyut3 ding6 laa1.
sentences.english: Where should we take a vacation this year? Let’s decide soon.

sentences.speaker: Melissa
sentences.cantonese: 嗯，我想去啲暖嘅地方。去沙灘點？又或者租間湖邊木屋。
sentences.jyutping: ng6, ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 di1 nyun5 ge3 dei6 fong1. heoi3 saa1 taan1 dim2? jau6 waak6 ze2 zou1 gaan1 wu4 bin1 muk6 uk1.
sentences.english: Well, I’d like to go somewhere warm. How about the beach? Or we could rent a cabin on the lake.

sentences.speaker: Jake
sentences.cantonese: 你又想去沙灘？我今年冬天想去滑雪喎。不如折衷下？下年四月去歐洲阿爾卑斯山點？可以搵到喺湖邊嘅滑雪度假村。
sentences.jyutping: nei5 jau6 soeng2 heoi3 saa1 taan1? ngo5 gam1 nin4 dung1 tin1 soeng2 heoi3 waat6 syut3 wo3. bat1 jyu4 zit3 cung1 haa5? haa6 nin4 sei3 jyut6 heoi3 au1 zau1 aa3 ji5 bei1 si1 saan1 dim2? ho2 ji5 wan2 dou2 hai2 wu4 bin1 ge3 waat6 syut3 dou6 gaa3 cyun1.
sentences.english: You want to go to the beach again? I want to ski this winter. How about a compromise? What about traveling to the Alps in Europe next April? We can find a ski resort on a lake.

sentences.speaker: Melissa
sentences.cantonese: 嘩，我哋未試過去歐洲㗎！但係我唔知到時會唔會有陽光同暖啲。我要先做吓資料搜集，咁先可以決定。
sentences.jyutping: waa1, ngo5 dei6 mei6 si3 gwo3 heoi3 au1 zau1 gaa3! daan6 hai6 ngo5 m4 zi1 dou3 si4 wui5 m4 wui5 jau5 joeng4 gwong1 tung4 nyun5 di1. ngo5 jiu3 sin1 zou6 haa5 zi1 liu2 sau2 zaap6, gam2 sin1 ho2 ji5 kyut3 ding6.
