sentences.english: Oh, we’ve never been to Europe before! But I don’t know if it will be sunny and warm then. I need to do some research first. That will help me make up my mind.

sentences.speaker: Ryan

sentences.english: I’m so happy this week of midterm exams is finished.

sentences.english: Same here. I’m looking forward to relaxing in the mountains this weekend. I’ve planned a little hike in the woods. And I’m gonna take a canoe trip down the river if the weather cooperates.

sentences.speaker: Ryan
sentences.cantonese: 好好玩喎！我就會去密芝根。我會帶埋相機，因為秋天好快到，啲樹葉已經開始變成唔同深淺嘅紅色同橙色。一定會好靚。

sentences.english: Oh, fun! I’m going to Michigan. I’m taking my camera because fall is coming fast. The leaves are already turning all shades of red and orange. It will be awesome.

sentences.speaker: Tyler
sentences.cantonese: 下次你再去嘅時候，我都要一齊去。我聽講密芝根係玩獨木舟嘅好地方。
sentences.jyutping: haa6 ci3 nei5 zoi3 heoi3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dou1 jiu3 jat1 cai4 heoi3. ngo5 teng1 gong2 mat6 zi1 gan1 hai6 waan2 duk6 muk6 zau1 ge3 hou2 dei6 fong1.
sentences.english: Next time you go there, I’ll join you. I’ve heard Michigan is a great place to go canoeing.

sentences.speaker: Angelica
sentences.cantonese: 新娘著嗰條婚紗係咪真係好靚？
sentences.jyutping: san1 noeng2 zoek3 go2 tiu4 fan1 saa1 hai6 mai6 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3?
sentences.english: Doesn’t the bride look beautiful in that wedding dress?

sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, keoi5 leng3 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5. ji4 ce2 san1 long4 hou2 long6 maan6. ngo5 aam1 aam1 teng1 dou2 keoi5 dei6 dim2 joeng2 kau4 fan1 gaa3! keoi5 hai2 leon4 deon1 zuk1 gwong1 maan5 caan1 go2 zan6 hoeng3 keoi5 kau4 fan1. nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 dou2 keoi5 dei6 hai2 go2 dou6 duk6 syu1?
sentences.english: Yes. She looks amazing. And the groom is so romantic. I just heard the story of how they got engaged! He proposed to her during a candlelight dinner in London. Did you know that was where they went to school?

sentences.speaker: Angelica
sentences.cantonese: 哦？真係好浪漫喎。仲有佢哋嘅蜜月！真係好主意！好多新人結婚之後只係去沙灘玩一個星期。但係佢哋就會去加州，駕電單車沿住海岸線旅行。
sentences.jyutping: o2? zan1 hai6 hou2 long6 maan6 wo3. zung6 jau5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 mat6 jyut6! zan1 hai6 hou2 zyu2 ji3! hou2 do1 san1 jan4 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6 zi2 hai6 heoi3 saa1 taan1 waan2 jat1 go3 sing1 kei4. daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 zau6 wui5 heoi3 gaa1 zau1, gaa3 din6 daan1 ce1 jyun4 zyu6 hoi2 ngon6 sin3 leoi5 hang4.
sentences.english: Oh? Wonderful. And the honeymoon! What a great idea! Most people just go to the beach for a week after they tie the knot. But they plan on heading to California and cruising the coast on their motorcycle.

sentences.speaker: Maria
sentences.cantonese: 真係咩！呢個主意太正啦。呢場婚禮係我去過最好嘅一場。
sentences.jyutping: zan1 hai6 me1! ni1 go3 zyu2 ji3 taai3 zing3 laa1. ni1 coeng4 fan1 lai5 hai6 ngo5 heoi3 gwo3 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 jat1 coeng4.
sentences.english: Really! What a fantastic idea. This is by far the best wedding I’ve ever been to.

sentences.speaker: Layla
sentences.cantonese: 多謝你喺午飯時間同我見面。我真係好感激。
sentences.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 hai2 ng5 faan6 si4 gaan3 tung4 ngo5 gin3 min6. ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 gam2 gik1.
sentences.english: Thanks for meeting with me during your lunch hour. I appreciate it.

sentences.speaker: Monica

sentences.jyutping: m4 gan2 jiu3 laa1. ngo5 lok6 ji3 bong1 nei5. faat3 sang1 me1 si6 aa3?

sentences.english: Oh you know, the usual. Should I take this new job? Or do I stick with my current one?

sentences.english: Well, I think it’s time for a change, don’t you? They pay you late and you are unhappy.

sentences.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 gam2 lam2?
sentences.english: Do you really think so?

sentences.jyutping: m4 goi1, jat1 go3 faan1 ke2 ngau4 naam4 min6, zau2 cung1 zau2 laat6.
sentences.english: Excuse me, one tomato beef brisket noodles, no green onions and not spicy.

sentences.english: I heard the observatory will hoist the No. 8 typhoon signal shortly.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.cantonese: 係呀？咁大家都要提早收工返屋企喇。
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3? gam3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 tai4 zou2 sau1 gung1 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa3.
sentences.english: Really? Then everyone will have to get off work early and go home.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.cantonese: 記得閂好門窗，外面啲嘢要收返入嚟。
sentences.jyutping: gei3 dak1 saan1 hou2 mun4 coeng1, ngoi6 min6 di1 je5 jiu3 sau1 faan1 jap6 lei4.
sentences.english: Remember to close all windows and doors, and bring in the things outside.

title: Taking a Walk in the Park

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.cantonese: 今日天氣咁好，不如去公園散下步？
sentences.jyutping: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 gam3 hou2, bat1 jyu4 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 saan3 haa5 bou6?
sentences.english: The weather is so nice today, how about we go for a walk in the park?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.cantonese: 好呀，行下草地、吸下新鮮空氣都好。
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3, hang4 haa5 cou2 dei6, kap1 haa5 san1 sin1 hung1 hei3 dou1 hou2.
sentences.english: Sure, walking on the grass and breathing some fresh air would be great.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.cantonese: 仲可以帶埋隻狗一齊去跑下。
sentences.jyutping: zung6 ho2 ji5 daai3 maai4 zek3 gau2 jat1 cai4 heoi3 paau2 haa5.
sentences.english: We can also take the dog along for a run.

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.cantonese: 唔該，呢度有咩招牌菜好介紹呀？
sentences.jyutping: m4 goi1, ni1 dou6 jau5 me1 ziu1 paai4 coi3 hou2 gaai3 siu3 aa3?
sentences.english: Excuse me, what are the signature dishes you recommend here?

sentences.speaker: Waiter
sentences.cantonese: 我哋嘅避風塘炒蟹同埋咕嚕肉都好出名。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ge3 bei6 fung1 tong4 caau2 haai5 tung4 maai4 gu1 lou1 juk6 dou1 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
sentences.english: Our Under Bridge Spicy Crab and Sweet and Sour Pork are very famous.

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.cantonese: 咁就要一份咕嚕肉試下先。
sentences.jyutping: gam3 zau6 jiu3 jat1 fan6 gu1 lou1 juk6 si3 haa5 sin1.
sentences.english: Then I'll try an order of Sweet and Sour Pork first.

sentences.speaker: Staff A
sentences.cantonese: 影印機好似無晒紙，你有無見到儲存室有？
sentences.jyutping: jing2 jan3 gei1 hou2 ci5 mou4 saai3 zi2, nei5 jau5 mou5 gin3 dou3 cyu5 cyun4 sat1 jau5?
sentences.english: The photocopier seems to be out of paper; did you see any in the storage room?

sentences.speaker: Staff B
sentences.cantonese: 最後嗰兩箱尋日用晒喇，要叫人送貨。
sentences.jyutping: zeoi3 hau6 go2 loeng5 soeng1 cam4 jat1 jung6 saai3 laa3, jiu3 giu3 jan4 sung3 fo3.
sentences.english: The last two boxes were used up yesterday; we need to order a delivery.

sentences.speaker: Staff A
sentences.cantonese: 咁快？咁我要叫 Admin 幫手訂喇。
sentences.jyutping: gam3 faai3? gam3 ngo5 jiu3 giu3 aa3 min1 bong1 sau2 deng6 laa3.
sentences.english: So soon? I'll have to ask Admin to help order some then.

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.cantonese: 唔該，個菠蘿包係咪啱啱出爐架？
sentences.jyutping: m4 goi1, go3 bo1 lo4 baau1 hai6 mai6 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 lou4 gaa3?
sentences.english: Excuse me, are the pineapple buns fresh out of the oven?

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.cantonese: 係呀，仲熱辣辣架，要幾個呀？
sentences.jyutping: hai6 aa3, zung6 jit6 laat6 laat6 gaa3, jiu3 gei2 go3 aa3?
sentences.english: Yes, they are still piping hot. How many would you like?

sentences.speaker: Customer
sentences.cantonese: 我要兩個，再要一排方包。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 loeng5 go3, zoi3 jiu3 jat1 paai4 fong1 baau1.
sentences.english: I'll take two, and a loaf of sliced bread.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.cantonese: 聽日就返去喇，仲未買到手信畀同事。
sentences.jyutping: ting1 jat1 zau6 faan1 heoi3 laa3, zung6 mei6 maai5 dou3 sau2 seon3 bei2 tung4 si6.
sentences.english: Going back tomorrow and I still haven't bought souvenirs for my colleagues.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.cantonese: 不如去呢間舖頭睇下，啲蝴蝶酥好出名。
sentences.jyutping: bat1 jyu4 heoi3 ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 tai2 haa5, di1 wu4 dip6 sou1 hou2 ceot1 ming4.
sentences.english: Why don't we check this shop? Their butterfly cookies are very famous.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.cantonese: 好呀，包裝幾精美，送禮幾大方。
sentences.jyutping: hou2 aa3, baau1 zong1 gei2 zing1 mei5, sung3 lai5 gei2 daai6 fong1.
sentences.english: Sure, the packaging is quite elegant; it makes a nice gift.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.cantonese: 聽聞你升咗做經理喎，恭喜晒！
sentences.jyutping: ting1 man4 nei5 sing1 zo2 zou2 ging1 lei5 wo3, gung1 hei2 saai3!
sentences.english: I heard you got promoted to manager, congratulations!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.cantonese: 多謝你呀，以後壓力大咗好多喇。
sentences.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 aa3, ji5 hau6 aat3 lik6 daai6 zo2 hou2 do1 laa3.
sentences.english: Thank you, there's going to be a lot more pressure from now on.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.cantonese: 你有實力，一定搞得掂嘅！
sentences.jyutping: nei5 jau5 sat6 lik6, jat1 ding6 gaau2 dak1 dim2 ge2!
sentences.english: You have the ability; you'll definitely be able to handle it!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.cantonese: 今晚決賽你撐邊隊呀？
sentences.jyutping: gam1 maan5 kyut3 coi3 nei5 caang1 bin1 deoi6 aa3?
sentences.english: Which team are you rooting for in the final tonight?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.cantonese: 我一定撐曼聯啦，佢哋最近狀態好惹火。
sentences.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 ding6 caang1 maan6 lyun4 laa1, keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 gan6 zong6 taai3 hou2 je5 fo2.
sentences.english: I'm definitely rooting for Manchester United; they've been in fiery form lately.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.cantonese: 未必喎，對手防守都好勁架。
sentences.jyutping: mei6 bit1 wo3, deoi3 sau2 fong4 sau2 dou1 hou2 ging6 gaa3.
sentences.english: Not necessarily; their opponent's defense is also very strong.
